# Alcoa Turns Raw Potential into Real Progress

Building a Legacy of Excellence for Future Generations

## Inspired by our vision and guided by our values

### Creating Impact

Our vision is to build a legacy of excellence for future generations. We’ll realize this vision by
running the safest and most reliable operations in the industry while growing our people and shaping
the future. We're turning today's work into a stronger future - not just for Alcoa, but for the
industry and world we help build.

video

Please enable *targeting cookies* to watch videos. You can enable targeting cookies on our [Cookie
Policy page][60].

### Our Commitment

Every day, you’ll find us striving to protect the safety and health of our global workforce and our
environment. We actively engage with our stakeholders in the communities where we operate. We are
focused on not just today, but tomorrow as well - for the people and communities who come next.

### Our People

From purposeful career development and inclusive and diverse work teams, Alcoa employees turn raw
potential into real progress. Today, we continue to channel the determination that first launched an
industry. We’re leading with the same boldness that shaped our history - and setting a new standard
that others will look to for generations.

## Alcoa Worldview

### Alcoa Australia’s Environmental Symposium Shines Light on World-Leading Research

Alcoa Australia’s Environmental Symposium saw 150 people from 34 organisations converge at Murdoch
University for some meaningful conversation.

Read More

### Alcoa, Port of Trois Rivières Inaugurate New Port Facilities Dedicated to Unloading Raw
### Materials for Deschambault Smelter

Alcoa and the Trois Rivières Port Authority (TRPA) officially inaugurated today Alcoa’s new
facilities at Wharf 17, marking an important milestone in the long-standing collaboration between
the two organizations.

Read More

### Alcoa Publishes 2025 Sustainability Report

On World Environment Day, Alcoa released its 2025 Sustainability Report, outlining the Company’s
approach to environmental, social and governance (ESG) topics and the progress made throughout the
year across its global operations.

Top-quality in terms of coverage and appearance! As the name suggests, these new metallic pastes
stand for **H**igh **D**ensity.

New inspirations for the cosmetic world in Autumn/Winter 2027/28: three looks defined by expressive

Simply the perfect pigment for paints with a medium to high solids content: high flop, yet a fine
and structureless appearance.

STANDART® ZInc Matt Black:

[MORE][157]

SILVET AD


Presenting the new SILVET AD series for solvent-based printing ink formulations: the pelletised
product form offers significant advantages!

**World premiere: ProFLAKE® Zn HYDRO PM 3090**


Our aqueous zinc flakes offer long-lasting corrosion protection – the first stabilised zinc flakes
for water-based systems on the market.

[READ MORE][159]

**MASTERSAFE pellet portfolio for plastics**

The best of ECKART and Silberline combined! Benefit from sustainable and safe products that offer a
perfect replacement for metallisation.

## See how our metals take shape from mines to homes to outer space

[ Read more ][178]

### Mines

### Refineries

### Smelters

### Flat rolled products (FRP)

### Extrusions

### Foils

### Specialty Alloys

[Mines]

### Mines

This is the first step in our integrated value chain. We operate 27 bauxite mines across Jharkhand,
Odisha, Chhattisgarh, and Maharashtra which are fueled by our four captive coal mines.

[Refineries]

### Refineries

Once bauxite is mined, it is processed into alumina at our state-of-the-art alumina refineries in
Utkal, Renukoot, Muri, and Belagavi.

[Smelters]

### Smelters

We extract aluminium from alumina at our smelters, which have a combined annual production capacity
of 1.3 million MT. Our smelters manufacture high-quality primary aluminium in the form of ingots,
billets and wire rods which are used across industrial settings.

[Flat rolled products (FRP)]

### Flat rolled products (FRP)

Along with our subsidiary Novelis, we lead the world in flat-rolled aluminium products, serving
diverse markets from construction to cookware. Our FRP offerings include hot rolled plates, fin
stock, pattern sheets, and cable wrap stock.

[Extrusions]

### Extrusions

Our customised aluminium extrusions are used across market segments in the making of vehicles,
electrical equipment, consumer appliances and other industrial machinery. Our two extrusion plants
are located at Renukoot and Alupuram.

[Foils]

### Foils

We are one of India’s leading manufacturers of foil and foil laminates which are used extensively in
packaging by pharmaceutical companies. Our food-grade aluminium foils are marketed under the popular
brand names – Freshwrapp and Superwrap.

[Specialty Alloys]

### Specialty Alloys

Hindalco through its subsidiary Hindalco-Almex Aerospace Limited (HAAL), is a proud supplier of
aerospace and defence grade aluminium alloys for India’s prestigious space missions like
Chandrayaan, Gaganyaan and other PSLV and GSLV launches.

## See how our metals take shape from mines to homes to outer space

[ Read more ][178]

### Mines

### Refineries

### Smelters

### Flat rolled products (FRP)

### Extrusions

### Foils

### Specialty Alloys

[Mines]

### Mines

This is the first step in our integrated value chain. We operate 27 bauxite mines across Jharkhand,
Odisha, Chhattisgarh, and Maharashtra which are fueled by our four captive coal mines.

[Refineries]

### Refineries

Once bauxite is mined, it is processed into alumina at our state-of-the-art alumina refineries in
Utkal, Renukoot, Muri, and Belagavi.

[Smelters]

### Smelters

We extract aluminium from alumina at our smelters, which have a combined annual production capacity
of 1.3 million MT. Our smelters manufacture high-quality primary aluminium in the form of ingots,
billets and wire rods which are used across industrial settings.

[Flat rolled products (FRP)]

### Flat rolled products (FRP)

Along with our subsidiary Novelis, we lead the world in flat-rolled aluminium products, serving
diverse markets from construction to cookware. Our FRP offerings include hot rolled plates, fin
stock, pattern sheets, and cable wrap stock.

[Extrusions]

### Extrusions

Our customised aluminium extrusions are used across market segments in the making of vehicles,
electrical equipment, consumer appliances and other industrial machinery. Our two extrusion plants
are located at Renukoot and Alupuram.

[Foils]

### Foils

We are one of India’s leading manufacturers of foil and foil laminates which are used extensively in
packaging by pharmaceutical companies. Our food-grade aluminium foils are marketed under the popular
brand names – Freshwrapp and Superwrap.

[Specialty Alloys]

### Specialty Alloys

Hindalco through its subsidiary Hindalco-Almex Aerospace Limited (HAAL), is a proud supplier of
aerospace and defence grade aluminium alloys for India’s prestigious space missions like
Chandrayaan, Gaganyaan and other PSLV and GSLV launches.

##### Driven by our Purpose of Shaping a Sustainable World Together, Novelis is recognized for
##### pioneering sustainable aluminum innovations. With Novelis 3×30 we aim to go further faster,
##### developing circular solutions to position aluminum as the material of choice for
##### manufacturers.

[Novelis 3×30][63]

## 12,750 valued employees worldwide

[Learn More ][64]

### Our commitment to environmental standards

[Learn More ][65]

### Exciting careers opportunities at Novelis

[Learn More ][66]

## What Solutions Can We Deliver for Your Market?

## Packaging

We deliver advanced packaging solutions designed for circularity and exceptional quality. Explore
how we’re driving the next generation of aluminum beverage cans, food packaging, coffee pods and
more.

[Learn More][67]

## Automotive

We’re driving automotive innovation with lightweight, low carbon aluminum solutions for parts,
components and processes that enhance performance, efficiency and sustainability. See how we’re
shaping the future of mobility.

[Learn More][68]

## Aerospace

We provide high-strength, lightweight aerospace aluminum that meets rigorous safety and performance
standards for aircraft. Find out how our innovative solutions keep the world flying.

[Learn more][69]

## Architecture & Building

From iconic facades to windows and roller shutters, we create custom aluminum solutions for projects
that demand durability, fire safety and circular materials. See how our building and construction
offerings bring ideas to life.

[Learn more][70]

## Industrial

We manufacture components for aluminum industrial applications, tooling, batteries, consumer goods,
transportation and more, helping industries build stronger, lighter and more innovative products.

[Learn more][71]

## Shaping a Sustainable World Together

Novelis partners with customers across all industries to deliver innovative, high‑performance
aluminum solutions that enable lighter, stronger, and more sustainable products. Our operations are
built around a circular business model, maximizing the use of recycled aluminum while continuously
reducing carbon emissions across our value chain. Through global scale, advanced rolling and
recycling capabilities, and deep technical expertise, we turn aluminum into a material that meets
the demands of today and tomorrow. Guided by our purpose, we work every day to shape a more
sustainable aluminum industry – together with our customers and partners.

## 12,750 valued employees worldwide

[Learn More ][64]

### Our commitment to environmental standards

[Learn More ][65]

### Exciting careers opportunities at Novelis

[Learn More ][66]

## What Solutions Can We Deliver for Your Market?

## Packaging

We deliver advanced packaging solutions designed for circularity and exceptional quality. Explore
how we’re driving the next generation of aluminum beverage cans, food packaging, coffee pods and
more.

[Learn More][67]

## Automotive

We’re driving automotive innovation with lightweight, low carbon aluminum solutions for parts,
components and processes that enhance performance, efficiency and sustainability. See how we’re
shaping the future of mobility.

[Learn More][68]

## Aerospace

We provide high-strength, lightweight aerospace aluminum that meets rigorous safety and performance
standards for aircraft. Find out how our innovative solutions keep the world flying.

[Learn more][69]

## Architecture & Building

From iconic facades to windows and roller shutters, we create custom aluminum solutions for projects
that demand durability, fire safety and circular materials. See how our building and construction
offerings bring ideas to life.

[Learn more][70]

## Industrial

We manufacture components for aluminum industrial applications, tooling, batteries, consumer goods,
transportation and more, helping industries build stronger, lighter and more innovative products.

[Learn more][71]

## Shaping a Sustainable World Together

Novelis partners with customers across all industries to deliver innovative, high‑performance
aluminum solutions that enable lighter, stronger, and more sustainable products. Our operations are
built around a circular business model, maximizing the use of recycled aluminum while continuously
reducing carbon emissions across our value chain. Through global scale, advanced rolling and
recycling capabilities, and deep technical expertise, we turn aluminum into a material that meets
the demands of today and tomorrow. Guided by our purpose, we work every day to shape a more
sustainable aluminum industry – together with our customers and partners.

# Home

We are a global advanced materials and recycling group. We reduce harmful emissions, power the
vehicles and technologies of today and tomorrow, and give new life to used metals.

[Discover Umicore][81]
Our markets & solutions

## From our lab to your home, and everywhere in between

[Automotive & Mobility][82]
[Energy][83]
[Electronics & Telecom][84]
[Recycling Solutions][85]
[Discover **all Umicore markets**.][86]

## Roadmap to 2028

Umicore's path forward to 2028 is grounded in our strengths and built on our solid foundations.

[Discover more][87]

## We are the circular materials technology company

With a closed-loop business model and leading innovation, we develop materials that transform
everyday life and improve the planet’s health. Through our expertise in material science, chemistry
and metallurgy, we meet the growing demand for metal-based technologies, recycling, cleaner
mobility, and advanced materials for energy, electronics and more. 

[About Umicore][88]

Materials for a better life

# Home

We are a global advanced materials and recycling group. We reduce harmful emissions, power the
vehicles and technologies of today and tomorrow, and give new life to used metals.

[Discover Umicore][81]
Our markets & solutions

## From our lab to your home, and everywhere in between

[Automotive & Mobility][82]
[Energy][83]
[Electronics & Telecom][84]
[Recycling Solutions][85]
[Discover **all Umicore markets**.][86]

## Roadmap to 2028

Umicore's path forward to 2028 is grounded in our strengths and built on our solid foundations.

[Discover more][87]

## We are the circular materials technology company

With a closed-loop business model and leading innovation, we develop materials that transform
everyday life and improve the planet’s health. Through our expertise in material science, chemistry
and metallurgy, we meet the growing demand for metal-based technologies, recycling, cleaner
mobility, and advanced materials for energy, electronics and more. 

[About Umicore][88]

# [ATL]

ATL is the world's leading producer and innovator of lithium-ion batteries. We are known worldwide
for our high-tech, high-volume prowess in developing, producing and packaging high quality
rechargeable lithium-ion battery cells and packs. Our service, know-how, production capacity and
system integration capability is impressively outstanding.

[more ][1]

### Products

[The ATL Li-ion battery product family includes high energy density, high power, fast charge and
arbitrary-shaped cells and so on. To cope with or even lead the market demand, we have developed
various types of li-ion battery cells to meet the needs of many different consumer electronics
devices.][2]

[more ][3]

### High Energy Density

[The energy density of cells is what determines the standby time and single charge range of such
essential devices as mobile phones, laptops and tablet PCs ......][4]

[more ][5]

### High Power

[ATL is the pioneer in High-power lithium cell technology, which is used extensively in consumer
electronics ......][6]

[more ][7]

### Fast Charge

[Fast charge has become an essential requirement in smart hardware development, something we have
known for a while ......][8]

[more ][9]

### Arbitrary Shaped Cell

[Life is only going to get smarter. Thanks to mankind's many unthinkable technological feats, AR/VR
and wearable devices ......][10]

[more ][11]

### Devices We Power

ATL is proud to design the batteries that power many electronic devices and empower the lives of
countless people that have come to rely on them.

Battery applications for smart phone, notebook, tablet, power bank, drone, robot, wearable device
and AR/VR, etc.

[more ][12]

### R&D and Smart Manufacturing

ATL Research Institute is a comprehensive laboratory which integrates material development, testing,
validation and other functions. Nearly 20 independent labs are under the jurisdiction. The strength
and number of patents of the research & development team are leading in the industry at home and
abroad.

Simulation, advanced material and more.

[more ][13]

### Social Responsibility

CSR (Corporate Social Responsibility) at ATL means aligning our business practices with the needs of
society while protecting the environment.

EESS LIB lithium battery energy storage system, each of the power reduction 4.238 tons CO2 .

[more ][14]

### Join Us

ATL believes that our employees constitute our most important assets. Our success is the result of
their talents, skills, energy, creativity and dedication. In order to attract, develop and retain
the people we need to succeed, we are committed to offering an environment where our employees can
thrive while having the opportunity to continue developing their careers.

You are the best, join us!

[more ][15]

the battery industry and e-mobility development.

## Sustaining Europe's battery powerhouse

Developed in Europe, made in Europe, and recycled in Europe, the Roadmap sets performance targets
for the next wave of advanced lead battery technology across every major application, including
automotive, energy storage, motive power, UPS and telecoms, defence, and nuclear power.

[Download now][22]

Energy storage

## Interactive Map

Delivering reliable, sustainable and cost-effective energy storage across the globe, lead batteries
are a high-performing technology delivering a greener future. Check out CBI's interactive map to see
examples of lead batteries in action for energy storage for utility and renewable projects.

[View the Interactive Map][23]

Find your lead battery match

## CBI Battery Match

CBI has developed an online tool allowing customers in the energy storage sector, from utility and
renewable energy companies to systems integrators, to easily find advanced batteries that provide
high performance, are affordable and reliable, whilst also being safe and sustainable. CBI Battery
Match is helping energy storage companies find the best lead battery option for their system.

[Find your battery match][24]

Membership

## The only global lead battery pre-competitive research organization

The Consortium for Battery Innovation is the only global pre-competitive research organization
funding innovation in lead batteries for energy storage and automotive applications.

[Learn more about membership][25]

# Know More About Us

Established in 1971, BFCL has grown into a trusted symbol of excellence, reliability, and
commitment. From its origins in steel ingot production, the company has emerged as India’s largest
producer of low and medium carbon ferro manganese. With exports spanning 25+ countries, we stand
proudly among India’s top five Ferro Alloy exporters.

Our diverse product portfolio includes all grades of ferro manganese and silico manganese, with an
annual production of approximately 100,000 MT of ferro alloys, including approximately 60,000 MT of
refined ferro manganese via the CLU route.

With more than five decades of expertise, BFCL continues to modernize its operations, ensuring
consistent quality through efficient raw material sourcing and advanced processes. Our commitment to
quality and long-standing customer relationships has established BFCL as a benchmark in the ferro
alloys industry—driving sustainable growth and global recognition.

## Our Products

[Thumbnail]

### Medium & low Carbon
### Ferro Manganese

### Medium & low Carbon
### Ferro Manganese

Our range encompasses Medium and Low Carbon Ferro Manganese in all Grades, with a manganese content
spanning 70-84%. Achieving extra low carbon content of up to 0.10% is made possible through the
advanced CLU converter.

[View Details][61]
[Thumbnail]

### High Carbon
### Ferro Manganese

### High Carbon
### Ferro Manganese

High Carbon Ferro Manganese, encompassing grades of 70-78% Mn, is produced via Submerged Electric
Arc Furnace.

[View Details][62]
[Thumbnail]

### Silico Manganese

### Silico Manganese

Our range of Silico Manganese grades, containing 60-68% Mn, is produced via a sub-merged electric
Arc Furnace. Silico Manganese enhances steel’s robustness and corrosion resistance.

[View Details][63]
[Thumbnail]

### Sponge Iron

### Sponge Iron

Processed through the direct reduction in DRI kilns, sponge iron emerges from iron and pellet ores.
This premium feedstock for steelmaking offers a cost-effective, eco-friendly alternative to
conventional extraction techniques.

[View Details][64]
[Thumbnail]

### MS Billets

### MS Billets

At BFCL, our specialization lies in producing premium-grade low-carbon MS billets. These are cast
within our steel unit equipped with an induction furnace with a Continuous Casting Machine.

[View Details][65]
[Thumbnail]

## Dr. Hari Krishna Budhia Founder and Managing Director

Founded by first-generation entrepreneur Dr. Hari Krishna Budhia, BFCL embodies over five decades of
excellence in the steel industry. After earning his Ph.D. in Chemical Engineering from the
University of Colorado, USA, in 1971, Dr. Budhia, together with his late brother Mr. A.R. Budhia,
established a steel manufacturing facility near Ranchi. Guided by his vision and leadership, BFCL
has evolved into a globally recognized name, exporting ferro alloys to more than 25 countries.

[Thumbnail]

## Mr. Gaurav Budhia Director

Under the leadership of Dr. H.K. Budhia’s successor, Mr. Gaurav Budhia, BFCL continues to thrive and
evolve. With over two decades of industry expertise, he has guided the company toward global
recognition by striking the right balance between product innovation, cost efficiency, operational
excellence, and sustainability. His unwavering commitment to higher performance standards has
propelled BFCL’s continued success. Mr. Gaurav Budhia envisions setting new industry benchmarks in
quality, customer satisfaction, and commitment—while upholding and advancing a remarkable legacy.

### Medium & low Carbon
### Ferro Manganese

### Medium & low Carbon
### Ferro Manganese

Our range encompasses Medium and Low Carbon Ferro Manganese in all Grades, with a manganese content
spanning 70-84%. Achieving extra low carbon content of up to 0.10% is made possible through the
advanced CLU converter.

[View Details][61]
[Thumbnail]

### High Carbon
### Ferro Manganese

### High Carbon
### Ferro Manganese

High Carbon Ferro Manganese, encompassing grades of 70-78% Mn, is produced via Submerged Electric
Arc Furnace.

[View Details][62]
[Thumbnail]

### Silico Manganese

### Silico Manganese

Our range of Silico Manganese grades, containing 60-68% Mn, is produced via a sub-merged electric
Arc Furnace. Silico Manganese enhances steel’s robustness and corrosion resistance.

[View Details][63]
[Thumbnail]

### Sponge Iron

### Sponge Iron

Processed through the direct reduction in DRI kilns, sponge iron emerges from iron and pellet ores.
This premium feedstock for steelmaking offers a cost-effective, eco-friendly alternative to
conventional extraction techniques.

[View Details][64]
[Thumbnail]

### MS Billets

### MS Billets

At BFCL, our specialization lies in producing premium-grade low-carbon MS billets. These are cast
within our steel unit equipped with an induction furnace with a Continuous Casting Machine.

## Dr. Hari Krishna Budhia Founder and Managing Director

Founded by first-generation entrepreneur Dr. Hari Krishna Budhia, BFCL embodies over five decades of
excellence in the steel industry. After earning his Ph.D. in Chemical Engineering from the
University of Colorado, USA, in 1971, Dr. Budhia, together with his late brother Mr. A.R. Budhia,
established a steel manufacturing facility near Ranchi. Guided by his vision and leadership, BFCL
has evolved into a globally recognized name, exporting ferro alloys to more than 25 countries.

[Thumbnail]

## Mr. Gaurav Budhia Director

Under the leadership of Dr. H.K. Budhia’s successor, Mr. Gaurav Budhia, BFCL continues to thrive and
evolve. With over two decades of industry expertise, he has guided the company toward global
recognition by striking the right balance between product innovation, cost efficiency, operational
excellence, and sustainability. His unwavering commitment to higher performance standards has
propelled BFCL’s continued success. Mr. Gaurav Budhia envisions setting new industry benchmarks in
quality, customer satisfaction, and commitment—while upholding and advancing a remarkable legacy.

BPI’s engineers use the latest cutting edge technology and software to provide a complete design

anaerobic digestion and biomass, and specialise in providing a complete design service for
substations and overhead lines at all voltages.

Since the 1970’s we have been providing advice to our clients, enabling them to maximise their
business and operational success. This is more important than ever in the current climate with tight
budgets, limited availability of capital, and close scrutiny by regulators and other stakeholders.

cost-efficient point of connection to 33 and 132kV tower lines, and the exciting new steel [Protean
system][78] which can replace wood poles or towers.  We also design and manufacture [protection
panels][79].

## **British Power International**
## The electrical design consultancy offering a complete 11-400kV design and advisory service for
## connections, substations and overhead lines

## [Design][74]

BPI’s engineers use the latest cutting edge technology and software to provide a complete design
service for EHV, HV and LV DNO networks.  They design for the renewables market in wind, solar, CHP,
anaerobic digestion and biomass, and specialise in providing a complete design service for
substations and overhead lines at all voltages.

## [Advisory][75]

Since the 1970’s we have been providing advice to our clients, enabling them to maximise their
business and operational success. This is more important than ever in the current climate with tight
budgets, limited availability of capital, and close scrutiny by regulators and other stakeholders.

## [Products][76]

The innovative team have developed the award winning [POC-MAST^{TM}][77] which provides a safe and
cost-efficient point of connection to 33 and 132kV tower lines, and the exciting new steel [Protean
system][78] which can replace wood poles or towers.  We also design and manufacture [protection
panels][79].

### What We Do

## Innovative EV Solution For Your Projects

We provide tailored EV solutions designed to meet your project requirements — from solution design
and system integration to calibration, testing, and delivery — all backed by comprehensive technical
support. Our solutions cover key EV systems with cutting-edge technologies, including electric
powertrain systems (motors, e-axles, controllers), battery systems (battery packs, BMS, BTMS, PDU),
steering and braking systems, and more. Designed for commercial applications such as trucks, buses,
trains, agriculture, construction, and mining equipment, our solutions help OEMs steamline sourcing,
reduce costs, and accelerate project timelines.
* Industry-Leading Technology to Keep You Ahead in the EV Industry

### We collaborate to help you build a better future by bringing your best ideas forward.

We do that by developing better materials and smarter processes that transform what you are able to
do and how you do it.

We grew to be one of the world’s leading specialty materials manufacturers by listening, learning,
and solving extreme challenges. We help you think it through. And then we help you make it. For over
100 years we have applied our materials and manufacturing expertise to help people like you realize
ideas and build success.

[About Us][157]
[Carpenter Technologies - Aerospace]

##### [AEROSPACE][158]

Superior materials for engines, landing gear, precision components, and metal powder additive
manufacturing.

[Carpenter Technologies - Automotive]

##### [Transportation][159]

Diverse specialty alloys for high-pressure fuel systems, engines, exhaust systems, oxygen sensors,
and other components.

[Carpenter Technologies - Consumer]

##### [Consumer][160]

Specialty alloys for durable and nondurable consumer goods applications from consumer electronics to
sporting goods.

[Carpenter Technologies - Defense]

##### [Defense][161]

Advanced specialty materials for smaller, lighter, more durable components used in mission critical
applications.

[Carpenter Technologies - Energy]

##### [Energy][162]

High-performance alloys and powders for power generation, renewables, and Oil and Gas drilling and
completions applications.

[Carpenter Technologies - Industrial]

##### [Industrial][163]

Corrosion, heat, and pressure resistant specialty alloys and stainless steels for valves, fittings,
and fasteners.

[Carpenter Technologies - Medical]

##### [Medical][164]

Titanium, stainless steel, and specialty alloys for surgical instruments, medical devices,
prosthetics, and orthopedics.

## MARKETS

Carpenter Technology is leading innovation and excellence by leveraging our technical strengths,
distinct products, and extraordinary process capabilities to provide you with value-added solutions
that create breakthrough results.

We help customers like you solve the most extreme materials challenges. Our high-performance
solutions are the critical component for tomorrow's successes, helping you achieve superior results
in all your current and anticipated problems.

MARKETS

mission critical applications.

## INNOVATION

Step inside the world of Carpenter Technology’s research and development to learn about our material
innovations and the breakthroughs in additive manufacturing and electrification technologies from
our team of nearly 200 metallurgists and application engineers.

We continue to push the latest advancements in materials science. Partnering with our customers, we
apply a rich 100-year history of expertise to meeting and exceeding their needs. We focus on
redefining the limits of what is possible with ongoing alloy research and developments advancing
emerging technologies such as additive manufacturing and magnetic stack lamination for
electrification.

##### CASE 15

### End-to-End Additive Manufacturing for the Mars Rover

##### CASE STUDY

Our additive manufacturing experts partnered with the NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory to iterate to
success on thin-walled, tight tolerance components for the PIXL. From deriving scale factors to
staying on mass budget, we share our lessons learned and best practices.

[ Learn More ][180]
[Titanium powder atomization additive manufacturing white paper]
02

##### CASE 25

### Plasma & Electrode Inert Gas Atomized Powder Comparison

##### White Paper

Our team of additive manufacturing experts produced this white paper with results supporting the key
conclusion that these Ti64 powders for additive manufacturing are statistically equivalent along
several quantitative measures, including oxygen level, contamination, density, flowability, and
morphology.

[ Learn More ][181]
[Hiperco stator stack white paper]
03

##### CASE 35

### Ordered Growth in
### Hiperco® 50 Alloys

##### White Paper

The Carpenter Electrification team understands the need for tight tolerance laminations for
challenging design criteria. Aware of a net dimensional change in Hiperco® 50 alloys after
post-fabrication annealing, we evaluated the root cause and designed a special process to improve
the dimensional change characteristics.

[ Learn More ][182]
[Additive Manufacturing with Nitinol White Paper]
04

## Delivering Power Solutions for the Next Generation

Power your energy transition with reliable, sustainable solutions. We help businesses reduce energy
costs, enhance energy resilience, and achieve asset flexibility through **on-site power generation
and battery energy storage** - delivering EPC solutions tailored for a cleaner, more resilient
future.

[ How We Support You ][227]
[ Previous ][228]
[ Next ][229]

## Our Energy Solutions

[products-mwm-gas-engines_500x325]

##### MWM Gas Engines

Improve energy cost savings, resilience, and sustainability with high-efficiency gas engines rated
400kWe - 4,500kWe.

[Learn more][230]
[Edina-FTM-Battery-Storage-Installation]

##### Battery Energy Storage

Store and discharge energy on-site and reduce your grid dependency with a Tier-1 BESS solution.

[Learn more][231]
[Diesel Generator within an acoustic enclosure]

##### Emergency Backup Generation

Ensuring power continuity 24/7 allowing your business to focus on its core activities.

[Learn more][232]
[containerised-genset-installation_1920x1440]

##### Engineering, Procurement, and Construction

From project design and installation to asset care, we deliver the total solution to reduce
ambiguity.

[Learn more][233]
[Containerised Diesel Generator]

##### Manufacturing

Accelerate your project programme with our range of control panels, switchgear, and acoustic
enclosures.

[Learn more][234]
[Edina Service Engineer]

##### Service

We provide expert asset care of your gas engines, standby generators, and battery storage to
maximise plant performance and guarantee 24/7 availability.

[Learn more][235]

## Backed by Super Energy Efficiency Public ESCO

Edina and EPSL (Edina Power Service Limited) Trigeneration Pvt Ltd are owned by Super Energy Service
Company (ESCO), Energy Efficiency Services Limited (EESL), under the Ministry of Power, Government
of India.

[ Discover MWM Gas Engines ][236]

## Why Edina?

shuffle

#### Agile scope of work

Whether you're procuring a single supply, a multi-plant configuration, or a hybrid system
integrating generation, battery storage, and balance of plant, our four decades of grid interfacing
and engineering expertise ensure your project's success.

strategy

#### Meet your strategic requirement

Our installations demonstrate some of the highest operational and availability figures in the
industry, ensuring the optimal performance of your on-site generation and battery storage asset to
maximise your return on investment.

handshake

#### Mitigate risk and expedite project delivery

Edina can deliver your engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) contract and manufacturing
requirements from a single point of delivery.

## Delivering Power Solutions for the Next Generation

Power your energy transition with reliable, sustainable solutions. We help businesses reduce energy
costs, enhance energy resilience, and achieve asset flexibility through **on-site power generation
and battery energy storage** - delivering EPC solutions tailored for a cleaner, more resilient
future.

[ How We Support You ][227]

[ Next ][229]

## Our Energy Solutions

[products-mwm-gas-engines_500x325]

##### MWM Gas Engines

Improve energy cost savings, resilience, and sustainability with high-efficiency gas engines rated
400kWe - 4,500kWe.

[Learn more][230]
[Edina-FTM-Battery-Storage-Installation]

##### Battery Energy Storage

Store and discharge energy on-site and reduce your grid dependency with a Tier-1 BESS solution.

[Learn more][231]
[Diesel Generator within an acoustic enclosure]

##### Emergency Backup Generation

Ensuring power continuity 24/7 allowing your business to focus on its core activities.

[Learn more][232]

##### Engineering, Procurement, and Construction

From project design and installation to asset care, we deliver the total solution to reduce
ambiguity.

[Learn more][233]
[Containerised Diesel Generator]

##### Manufacturing

Accelerate your project programme with our range of control panels, switchgear, and acoustic
enclosures.

[Learn more][234]
[Edina Service Engineer]

##### Service

We provide expert asset care of your gas engines, standby generators, and battery storage to
maximise plant performance and guarantee 24/7 availability.

[Learn more][235]

## Backed by Super Energy Efficiency Public ESCO

Edina and EPSL (Edina Power Service Limited) Trigeneration Pvt Ltd are owned by Super Energy Service
Company (ESCO), Energy Efficiency Services Limited (EESL), under the Ministry of Power, Government
of India.

shuffle

Whether you're procuring a single supply, a multi-plant configuration, or a hybrid system
integrating generation, battery storage, and balance of plant, our four decades of grid interfacing
and engineering expertise ensure your project's success.

strategy

#### Meet your strategic requirement

Our installations demonstrate some of the highest operational and availability figures in the
industry, ensuring the optimal performance of your on-site generation and battery storage asset to
maximise your return on investment.

handshake

#### Mitigate risk and expedite project delivery

Edina can deliver your engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) contract and manufacturing
requirements from a single point of delivery.

October 30, 2025
Copper sets new record above $11,140/t on supply shocks and hopes of US–China thaw

Copper prices climbed to a fresh record on October 29, 2025, breaching $11,140 per metric ton on the
London Metal Exchange as supply disruptions and improving risk sentiment tightened the market. The
rally followed weeks of outages at major operations, including a deadly mud slide at Indonesia’s
Grasberg mine that curtailed output, alongside weaker production guidance from several large Latin
American producers. Traders also cited optimism around easing US–China trade tensions ahead of
high‑level talks this week, which bolstered expectations for manufacturing and power‑grid spending
that are copper‑intensive. Intraday, the LME three‑month contract topped the prior all‑time high set
in May 2024 before paring some gains later in the session. Analysts said speculative inflows have
amplified moves amid historically low exchange inventories and tight concentrate availability
feeding smelters. Demand from electrification end‑markets—EVs, data centers and transmission
upgrades—remains a key support, while US policy signals and tariffs have encouraged pre‑buying and
stockpiling by downstream users. Some banks warned volatility could remain elevated if macro
conditions shift or if mine restarts accelerate. Still, the immediate balance is seen tight into
2026 given delays to new projects and lingering weather and operational risks at existing assets.
The new peak underscores how quickly the market’s focus has swung from macro growth worries to
supply scarcity as the year closes.

[Non Ferrous][29]
October 30, 2025
EU scrutinizes Anglo American’s $500m sale of Brazilian nickel assets to MMG

European Commission officials are reviewing Anglo American’s proposed $500 million divestment of
Brazilian nickel assets to Hong Kong‑listed MMG, with remedies under discussion after concerns that
the deal could constrain supply for European customers. According to people familiar with the
process on October 29, 2025, one remedy floated involved Anglo committing to buy ferronickel from
MMG for resale in Europe over a 10‑year period, but regulators have yet to seek market feedback and
the adequacy of proposals remains uncertain. The preliminary review is expected to conclude by
November 4. The transaction forms part of Anglo’s portfolio streamlining amid a re‑rating of
base‑metals businesses, while MMG seeks to expand in battery metals. The EU’s scrutiny comes against
a backdrop of heightened sensitivity to supply concentration and China‑linked ownership in critical
minerals. Any conditions could shape how much material is ultimately available to EU stainless steel
and alloy producers, many of whom faced tight feedstock earlier this year due to mine disruptions
and lower concentrate availability. Both companies said they remain engaged with regulators to
ensure competition is preserved and European buyers have continuity of supply. A protracted review
could delay closing and create near‑term uncertainty in regional procurement plans for nickel units
used in stainless steel and battery supply chains.

[Steel & Metal][30]
October 30, 2025
Iron ore futures extend gains as China outlines stricter steel capacity controls

Iron ore prices advanced on October 29, 2025, after China proposed tougher rules to restrain
steelmaking capacity, a move viewed as supportive for mill margins and raw‑material demand near
term. The most‑traded January contract on Dalian rose about 1.35% to 788 yuan/t ($110.63), while
November Singapore futures edged up to $105.75/t during Asian trading. Sentiment improved as higher
finished‑steel prices created buying headroom for mills to replenish ore inventories, according to
market commentary. Last week, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology released a draft
“capacity swap” framework that would forbid adding or transferring capacity in key smog‑control
regions and require at least 1.5 tonnes of old capacity to be retired for each new tonne
installed—tighter than previous rules paused in 2024. Analysts said the policy aims to stabilize
utilization rates, reduce overcapacity and encourage cleaner electric‑arc furnace production over
time. While the measures are structural, near‑term pricing was also aided by restocking after the
holiday period and expectations for additional macro support to manufacturing. Iron ore benchmarks
remain sensitive to any follow‑through on production curbs in northern hubs and to evolving US–China
trade dynamics. Market participants will watch for implementation details and mill compliance, which
historically has varied by region and season.

[Non Ferrous][31]
October 30, 2025
Copper hits $11,200/t record as supply worries persist; analysts caution rally may cool

On October 30, 2025, copper prices were reported to have surged to an all‑time high of $11,200 per
metric ton on October 29, driven by renewed concerns over mine supply and optimism around a
potential U.S.–China trade deal. Copper is up more than 27% in 2025, with the rally also supported
by a weaker U.S. dollar and lower interest rates. The latest leg higher followed production updates
from major miners: Glencore and Anglo American reported lower copper output for the first nine
months of 2025 and cut full‑year guidance, intensifying supply concerns. While the price spike
reflects tight supply, several analysts flagged risks to sustainability due to limited evidence of
robust end‑user demand growth. The International Copper Study Group projects a refined copper market
deficit of about 150,000 tons in 2026. Some banks and brokers nevertheless expect looser balances
beyond next year: Panmure Liberum’s Tom Price said current bullish factors appear largely priced in
and forecast a small surplus in 2026, while WisdomTree’s Nitesh Shah warned speculative enthusiasm
could fade. Goldman Sachs forecasts copper trading in a $10,000–$11,000/t range in 2026–2027 on
expectations of a likely surplus, though it maintains a constructive longer‑term view. The latest
move extends a year of sharp volatility in base metals as markets react to shifting macro and supply
signals.

[Steel & Metal][32]
October 30, 2025
Baosteel Q3 net profit jumps 130% on demand recovery and resilient exports

Baoshan Iron & Steel (Baosteel), China’s largest listed steelmaker and a unit of China Baowu,
reported on October 30, 2025 that third‑quarter net profit rose to 3.08 billion yuan (about $432
million), up 130% from 1.34 billion yuan a year earlier, citing stronger domestic demand and
continued resilience in export orders. The company said demand from high‑end manufacturing and
new‑energy sectors supported results despite ongoing industry challenges such as high costs and
persistent oversupply. For January–September 2025, Baosteel’s net profit increased 35.32% year on
year to 7.96 billion yuan. Operationally, Baosteel produced 12.77 million tons of pig iron and 13.06
million tons of steel in the third quarter, bringing nine‑month totals to 36.48 million tons and
38.79 million tons, respectively. Export activity remained firm: Baosteel captured 5.17 million tons
of export orders in the first three quarters, up 10.9% from the prior year, and the company is
targeting 15 million tons of exports in 2026. Management nonetheless noted that the sector faces
pressure from elevated input costs and the need for structural upgrades. The update underscores
contrasting themes in global steel: strong Chinese export pipelines amid trade frictions and
selective domestic demand recovery. Figures were disclosed in Baosteel’s quarterly communication
released Thursday.

[Steel & Metal][30]
October 30, 2025
Iron ore futures extend gains as China outlines stricter steel capacity controls

Iron ore prices advanced on October 29, 2025, after China proposed tougher rules to restrain
steelmaking capacity, a move viewed as supportive for mill margins and raw‑material demand near
term. The most‑traded January contract on Dalian rose about 1.35% to 788 yuan/t ($110.63), while
November Singapore futures edged up to $105.75/t during Asian trading. Sentiment improved as higher
finished‑steel prices created buying headroom for mills to replenish ore inventories, according to
market commentary. Last week, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology released a draft
“capacity swap” framework that would forbid adding or transferring capacity in key smog‑control
regions and require at least 1.5 tonnes of old capacity to be retired for each new tonne
installed—tighter than previous rules paused in 2024. Analysts said the policy aims to stabilize
utilization rates, reduce overcapacity and encourage cleaner electric‑arc furnace production over
time. While the measures are structural, near‑term pricing was also aided by restocking after the
holiday period and expectations for additional macro support to manufacturing. Iron ore benchmarks
remain sensitive to any follow‑through on production curbs in northern hubs and to evolving US–China
trade dynamics. Market participants will watch for implementation details and mill compliance, which
historically has varied by region and season.

[Non Ferrous][31]
October 30, 2025
Copper hits $11,200/t record as supply worries persist; analysts caution rally may cool

On October 30, 2025, copper prices were reported to have surged to an all‑time high of $11,200 per
metric ton on October 29, driven by renewed concerns over mine supply and optimism around a
potential U.S.–China trade deal. Copper is up more than 27% in 2025, with the rally also supported
by a weaker U.S. dollar and lower interest rates. The latest leg higher followed production updates
from major miners: Glencore and Anglo American reported lower copper output for the first nine
months of 2025 and cut full‑year guidance, intensifying supply concerns. While the price spike
reflects tight supply, several analysts flagged risks to sustainability due to limited evidence of
robust end‑user demand growth. The International Copper Study Group projects a refined copper market
deficit of about 150,000 tons in 2026. Some banks and brokers nevertheless expect looser balances
beyond next year: Panmure Liberum’s Tom Price said current bullish factors appear largely priced in
and forecast a small surplus in 2026, while WisdomTree’s Nitesh Shah warned speculative enthusiasm
could fade. Goldman Sachs forecasts copper trading in a $10,000–$11,000/t range in 2026–2027 on
expectations of a likely surplus, though it maintains a constructive longer‑term view. The latest
move extends a year of sharp volatility in base metals as markets react to shifting macro and supply
signals.

[Steel & Metal][32]
October 30, 2025
Baosteel Q3 net profit jumps 130% on demand recovery and resilient exports

Baoshan Iron & Steel (Baosteel), China’s largest listed steelmaker and a unit of China Baowu,
reported on October 30, 2025 that third‑quarter net profit rose to 3.08 billion yuan (about $432
million), up 130% from 1.34 billion yuan a year earlier, citing stronger domestic demand and
continued resilience in export orders. The company said demand from high‑end manufacturing and
new‑energy sectors supported results despite ongoing industry challenges such as high costs and
persistent oversupply. For January–September 2025, Baosteel’s net profit increased 35.32% year on
year to 7.96 billion yuan. Operationally, Baosteel produced 12.77 million tons of pig iron and 13.06
million tons of steel in the third quarter, bringing nine‑month totals to 36.48 million tons and
38.79 million tons, respectively. Export activity remained firm: Baosteel captured 5.17 million tons
of export orders in the first three quarters, up 10.9% from the prior year, and the company is
targeting 15 million tons of exports in 2026. Management nonetheless noted that the sector faces
pressure from elevated input costs and the need for structural upgrades. The update underscores
contrasting themes in global steel: strong Chinese export pipelines amid trade frictions and
selective domestic demand recovery. Figures were disclosed in Baosteel’s quarterly communication
released Thursday.

Discover the top coolest headquarters and corporate offices in the world—iconic workplaces known for
innovative design, creative architecture, and inspiring office environments. These world-class
company headquarters set new standards for modern corporate office culture, blending functionality
with bold aesthetics to create spaces that employees genuinely enjoy working in every day.

From cutting-edge technology campuses to architecturally stunning corporate offices, these
headquarters showcase how thoughtful design, open collaboration spaces, and employee-focused
amenities can transform the workplace experience. Each headquarters highlights unique approaches to
office layout, sustainability, wellness, and creativity, making them a powerful source of
inspiration for corporate office management teams and business leaders worldwide.

To explore these incredible headquarters in action and see what makes them stand out, watch the
video below for a visual tour of some of the coolest corporate offices in the world:

If you have ever wondered what it would be like to work in a truly inspiring corporate environment,
these headquarters represent the ultimate vision of modern office life. They are not just
offices—they are destinations that reflect company culture, innovation, and forward-thinking
leadership, and they continue to influence how organizations design and manage their headquarters
across the globe.

## **What can you find in a company headquarters?**

In a company headquarters, you will typically find the organization’s leadership team along with its
most critical business functions. These departments and offices work together to manage strategy,
operations, and long-term growth:
* **Chief Executive Officer (CEO) Office** – Responsible for overall vision, leadership, and
  strategic decision-making.
* **Executive Team & Board of Directors** – Oversees corporate governance, policy direction, and
  high-level business objectives.
* **Administration Office** – Handles internal coordination, office management, and organizational
  support functions.
* **Finance, Accounting & Billing Department** – Manages budgets, financial reporting, payroll,
  billing, and compliance.
* **Marketing & Communications Department** – Develops branding, public relations, advertising, and
  internal and external communications.
* **Sales Department** – Drives revenue generation, client acquisition, and business development
  efforts.
* **Customer Service & Support** – Provides assistance to customers, manages inquiries, and resolves
  issues.
* **Research & Development Department** – Focuses on innovation, product development, and improving
  existing services or technologies.
* **Operations & Logistics** – Oversees daily business operations, supply chains, and operational
  efficiency.
* **Human Resources Department** – Manages recruitment, employee relations, benefits, training, and
  workplace policies.
* **Legal Department** – Handles contracts, regulatory compliance, risk management, and legal
  matters affecting the company.

Together, these offices form the operational and strategic core of a company, making the
headquarters the central hub for leadership, planning, and decision-making.

# **Company Headquarters**

Company Headquarters is a comprehensive and authoritative directory hub dedicated to providing
accurate, up-to-date headquarters information for tens of thousands of leading companies across the
United States and around the world. Our platform is designed to serve as a trusted resource for
users who are searching for reliable corporate headquarters details in one centralized location.

We provide this headquarters information completely free of charge, making it easy to access
essential company data without subscriptions or hidden fees. Our listings include verified corporate
phone numbers, headquarters addresses, office locations, official websites, login portals, and
additional company-related information that users frequently search for online. Every detail
published on Company Headquarters is carefully reviewed to ensure clarity, accuracy, and usefulness.

Behind the scenes, our dedicated team works around the clock to collect, organize, and validate
headquarters data from multiple reliable sources. Each company profile goes through a detailed
process of sorting, data cleaning, and verification before it is published on our website. This
process ensures that outdated, incomplete, or misleading information is minimized, and that users
can rely on our directory with confidence.

Company Headquarters is committed to maintaining one of the most reliable and user-friendly
headquarters information directories available online. By continuously monitoring data updates and
verifying corporate details, we make sure the best and most accurate headquarters information is
accessible to users at all times, helping them quickly find the corporate contact and location
details they need, all in one convenient place.

Browse through our carefully selected headquarters listings to quickly locate the company
headquarters you are searching for, whether the organization operates locally, nationally, or
internationally. Our structured headquarters lists are organized for easy navigation, allowing users
to explore companies by name, category, or relevance and efficiently access accurate corporate
headquarters information in just a few clicks.

For a faster and more direct experience, you can also use the headquarters search box to search
across our complete headquarters directory. This powerful search feature enables you to instantly
find detailed company headquarters information, including corporate phone numbers, official
addresses, office locations, websites, and additional verified data, all from one centralized
platform.

## **Top Coolest Headquarters in the World**

Discover the top coolest headquarters and corporate offices in the world—iconic workplaces known for
innovative design, creative architecture, and inspiring office environments. These world-class
company headquarters set new standards for modern corporate office culture, blending functionality
with bold aesthetics to create spaces that employees genuinely enjoy working in every day.

From cutting-edge technology campuses to architecturally stunning corporate offices, these
headquarters showcase how thoughtful design, open collaboration spaces, and employee-focused
amenities can transform the workplace experience. Each headquarters highlights unique approaches to
office layout, sustainability, wellness, and creativity, making them a powerful source of
inspiration for corporate office management teams and business leaders worldwide.

To explore these incredible headquarters in action and see what makes them stand out, watch the
video below for a visual tour of some of the coolest corporate offices in the world:

If you have ever wondered what it would be like to work in a truly inspiring corporate environment,
these headquarters represent the ultimate vision of modern office life. They are not just
offices—they are destinations that reflect company culture, innovation, and forward-thinking
leadership, and they continue to influence how organizations design and manage their headquarters
across the globe.

## **What can you find in a company headquarters?**

In a company headquarters, you will typically find the organization’s leadership team along with its
most critical business functions. These departments and offices work together to manage strategy,
operations, and long-term growth:
* **Chief Executive Officer (CEO) Office** – Responsible for overall vision, leadership, and
  strategic decision-making.
* **Executive Team & Board of Directors** – Oversees corporate governance, policy direction, and
  high-level business objectives.
* **Administration Office** – Handles internal coordination, office management, and organizational
  support functions.
* **Finance, Accounting & Billing Department** – Manages budgets, financial reporting, payroll,
  billing, and compliance.
* **Marketing & Communications Department** – Develops branding, public relations, advertising, and
  internal and external communications.
* **Sales Department** – Drives revenue generation, client acquisition, and business development
  efforts.
* **Customer Service & Support** – Provides assistance to customers, manages inquiries, and resolves
  issues.
* **Research & Development Department** – Focuses on innovation, product development, and improving
  existing services or technologies.
* **Operations & Logistics** – Oversees daily business operations, supply chains, and operational
  efficiency.
* **Human Resources Department** – Manages recruitment, employee relations, benefits, training, and
  workplace policies.
* **Legal Department** – Handles contracts, regulatory compliance, risk management, and legal
  matters affecting the company.

Together, these offices form the operational and strategic core of a company, making the
headquarters the central hub for leadership, planning, and decision-making.

## IBMA

## Goals

We strive to promote and develop scientific research to innovate new technology in the field of
battery products.

## ENGAGEMENT

We intend to engage with various policy making forums at different levels

## STANDARDS

We work to develop manufacturing and recycling standards of battery industry

## SUPPLY CHAIN

We endeavor to strengthen capital equipment tooling with import substitution of key components

We conduct public awareness campaigns and thought leadership sessions for benefit of battery
industry

We are committed for environmental preservation, friendly recycling, quality and performance
improvement of Lead Acid Battery. We are group of renowned personalities of Indian Lead Acid Battery
Industry

Shaping an Innovative Future INTEGRALS POWER

## ABOUT US


Integrals power Limited (IPL) is a next-generation battery nano-material company committed to
accelerated research, development and commercialisation of state-of-the-art battery.
The team of entrepreneurs, scientists and engineers have conducted comprehensive market verification
& validation to form their strategy for the development of commercially feasible state-of-the-art
battery materials. This broad market research empowered the accelerated development and production
of Integrals power proprietary high-performance, cost effective and scalable battery cathode
materials such as Lithium Iron Phosphate (LFP) for lithium based batteries. IPL’s latest battery
material development results empower economical cells with higher performance compared to the
conventional alternatives.

IPL was formed with a strong dedication to present innovative, performance based battery material
solutions to support transition to zero carbon energy applications. Our mission is committed to
enabling mass uptake of battery powered solutions globally and reduce CO2 emissions. IPL works
closely with valuable academic and industrial partners in collaborative government funded projects
to accelerate the commercialisation and scale-up of novel nano materials.

[IPL Battery Technology Video][7]

## OUR SERVICES

[Test Engineering]

#### [Test Engineering][8]

Integrals power delivers battery test engineering solutions and systems for nano-materials and
renewable energy sector. Identifying errors as early as possible reduces subsequent errors and
further costs, resulting in accelerated development with higher chance of execution.

[Requirement Engineering]

#### [ Nano Materials Scale-up][9]

Integrals power offers services as a project collaborator or contractor for nano-materials and
battery chemistry scale-up. Based on previous successful scale-up projects of nano-materials,
Integrals power Identifies this sections= as the biggest hurdle in commercialising and scaling a
technology to mature its readiness level.

[Automation and control]

#### [ Battery Material Development][10]

Integrals Power develops novel battery cathode chemistries with higher performance for lithium based
batteries. Based on several years of experience in battery material development for different
applications including EV, Aerospace and Off-grid energy storage, we are happy to accept new
challenges in collaborative battery material development and broaden the product portfolio.

## TECHNOLOGY


##### Current lithium-ion batteries can’t keep up with the present needs and our electrified future.
##### 
##### High costs, power and capacity limitations prevent from the mass adoption of electric vehicles
##### and drives end users away from future electrified adoption. Many EV manufacturers have adopted
##### LFP as their alternative cathode material for lithium-Ion batteries.
##### 
##### Unreliable, inconsistent and low performance LFP has been identified as the main challenge for
##### battery manufacturers and end-users.

[test 05-big logo]
[test-04-final-2]

##### Integrals Power’s scientists and engineering team are focused on developing next generation
##### lithium-ion & lithium metal batteries through leading cathode materials development and

## ABOUT US


Integrals power Limited (IPL) is a next-generation battery nano-material company committed to
accelerated research, development and commercialisation of state-of-the-art battery.
The team of entrepreneurs, scientists and engineers have conducted comprehensive market verification
& validation to form their strategy for the development of commercially feasible state-of-the-art
battery materials. This broad market research empowered the accelerated development and production
of Integrals power proprietary high-performance, cost effective and scalable battery cathode
materials such as Lithium Iron Phosphate (LFP) for lithium based batteries. IPL’s latest battery
material development results empower economical cells with higher performance compared to the
conventional alternatives.

IPL was formed with a strong dedication to present innovative, performance based battery material
solutions to support transition to zero carbon energy applications. Our mission is committed to
enabling mass uptake of battery powered solutions globally and reduce CO2 emissions. IPL works
closely with valuable academic and industrial partners in collaborative government funded projects
to accelerate the commercialisation and scale-up of novel nano materials.

[IPL Battery Technology Video][7]

## OUR SERVICES

[Test Engineering]

#### [Test Engineering][8]

Integrals power delivers battery test engineering solutions and systems for nano-materials and
renewable energy sector. Identifying errors as early as possible reduces subsequent errors and
further costs, resulting in accelerated development with higher chance of execution.

[Requirement Engineering]

#### [ Nano Materials Scale-up][9]

Integrals power offers services as a project collaborator or contractor for nano-materials and
battery chemistry scale-up. Based on previous successful scale-up projects of nano-materials,
Integrals power Identifies this sections= as the biggest hurdle in commercialising and scaling a
technology to mature its readiness level.

[Automation and control]

#### [ Battery Material Development][10]

Integrals Power develops novel battery cathode chemistries with higher performance for lithium based
batteries. Based on several years of experience in battery material development for different
applications including EV, Aerospace and Off-grid energy storage, we are happy to accept new
challenges in collaborative battery material development and broaden the product portfolio.

## TECHNOLOGY


##### Current lithium-ion batteries can’t keep up with the present needs and our electrified future.
##### 
##### High costs, power and capacity limitations prevent from the mass adoption of electric vehicles
##### and drives end users away from future electrified adoption. Many EV manufacturers have adopted
##### LFP as their alternative cathode material for lithium-Ion batteries.
##### 
##### Unreliable, inconsistent and low performance LFP has been identified as the main challenge for
##### battery manufacturers and end-users.

[test 05-big logo]
[test-04-final-2]

##### Integrals Power’s scientists and engineering team are focused on developing next generation
##### lithium-ion & lithium metal batteries through leading cathode materials development and
##### manufacturing to support transition to zero carbon energy applications.
##### 
##### Combining Integrals Power’s advanced cathodes developments with state-of-the-art cell
##### technology, delivers hi-performance battery cells, packs and systems for the most demanding
##### applications. Our state-of-the-art, environmentally-friendly battery technology is extremely
##### repeatable and scalable at a very low cost.
##### 
##### This development will redefine the standard for battery production and performance as it is
##### significant to break out of the decades long incremental approach to developing an optimized
##### battery.
##### 
##### The basis of the operation of lithium-based batteries relies on the exchange of lithium-ions
##### between the anode and cathode. Cathodes are the main limiting factor in battery performance
##### and are where the most valuable metals lie. By improving battery material particle properties,
##### it is possible to produce a lithium-ion battery that offers significantly better performance.

##### Integrals Power is developing high-performance, safe and reliable battery cathode materials
##### including LFP and LFMP by collaborating with UK government and performing numerous R&D
##### validation tests on advanced battery materials.
##### 
##### Our innovative approach is known as bottom-up which allows Integrals Power cathode materials
##### to offer higher capacity retention and discharge rates within normal and extreme environmental
##### temperatures.
##### 
##### The bottom-up approach further comprises of creating nano-materials and objects based on
##### atoms, molecules, and aggregate grouping. Bottom-up syntheses are additive, like a tree that
##### grows from a small seed, albeit utilising chemistry to control structure.
##### 
##### Inspiration for bottom-up approaches comes from biological systems, where nature has harnessed
##### chemical forces to create essentially all the structures needed by life. This approach
##### replicates nature’s ability to produce small clusters of specific atoms, which can then
##### self-assemble into more-elaborate structures.

#### Low Cost

Batteries must accomplish market cost targets in order to make a truly sustainable future dream come
true. Integrals power considers this factor as one of the crucial segments of battery development
and key enabler for future electrification.

#### High power density

Offering high battery power density is challenging due to low capacity and limited discharge rates.
Integrals Power has tackled both of these challenges and can offer high power density by relying on
its higher capacity retention and high discharge rates.

#### High capacity retention

Current batteries struggle with high capacity fading specifically during different environmental
temperatures and higher discharge rates. Integrals power LFP has added on average 30% more capacity
which can reach up to 300% more in extreme environmental temperatures compared to benchmark.

#### Long cycle life

Elevated temperature and fast charge/discharge can lead to capacity fade over time for batteries.
Integrals power’s approach in minimising capacity loss can maintain the high life span of battery.

# Inventus Battery Energy Technologies

Battery Technology Development Centre
The One-Stop-Shop for all your New Energy Battery Technology needs

[ Welcome to Inventus ][35]

#### Discover our Cell Testing Solutions



#### Our Business Focus

Under the new energy paradigm with the tagline “Empowering the Future with Solid-State Battery
Innovation,” Inventus aims to address the challenges posed by traditional Li-ion batteries—namely
safety, limited energy density, charging time, and waste disposal—by offering a groundbreaking
solution: Solid-State Batteries (SSBs). Recognized as the “holy grail” of EV batteries, SSBs are
deep-tech products that promise significant advancements. With its indigenously developed
technology, Inventus is poised to make a substantial leap in advancing the cell manufacturing
ecosystem in India, serving as a one-stop technology shop for all new-age lithium battery cell
production needs.

Inventus Battery Energy (IBE™) Technologies (P) Ltd is a unique startup specializing in new energy
battery technologies, including Cathode-Active Materials (LFP, LMFP, NMC, and LNMO CAMs), LiPF6
electrolyte manufacturing know-how, and ACC manufacturing technology formulations (LFP and NMC
chemistries). Inventus holds several unique patented processes and offers licensing to
manufacturers.

The company provides clients with turnkey solutions for LIB cell manufacturing (MWh and GWh plants)
and supports the commercial-scale production of raw materials such as Pre-CAM, CAM, and LiPF6 liquid
electrolytes (ranging from 200 to 20,000 liters per day).

Committed to supporting the national mission on Advanced Cell Chemistry (ACC) and Battery Energy
Storage, IBE offers indigenous patented advanced battery cell technologies, including cell chemistry
know-how and process formulation, bundled with comprehensive turnkey project support. Specifically,
IBE™ meets India’s energy storage industry needs by offering complete end-to-end turnkey solutions
that include CAPEX, OPEX, ROI, plant design, and customization.

Our turnkey solutions encompass end-to-end process know-how, factory infrastructure design,
machinery supplier recommendations, and CAPEX and OPEX for giga factories. We provide well-rounded
consultancy services for battery risk mitigation, addressing fire incidents, and assisting with
DFMEA for Li-ion cell manufacturing industries.

Our cutting-edge solid-state battery technology has reached TRL 8, and our flexible ceramic oxide
tape cast electrolyte technology facilitates roll-to-roll cell manufacturing, reducing the need for
capital-intensive machinery. Inventus welcomes joint development partners (JDP) and joint venture
(JV) equity-based business propositions for its disruptive Protected Lithium Metal Cassette (PLC)
anode-based all-solid-state battery technology, currently at TRL 8. Our ASSB, powered by the
flexible Ceramion+™ technology, is designed to seamlessly integrate with existing Li-Ion cell
manufacturing infrastructure. This innovative solution eliminates the need for specialized equipment
or applied stake pressure to operate the cell or battery system—making it a standout feature and a
key USP of our Ceramion+™ technology.


#### Major Services

#### **We offer the following technology services to LIB Cell manufacturing industries as part of
#### the complete industrialization drive in India.**
1. Know-how licensing of Cell Chemistry and Turn-key solutions to LIB Cell Manufacturing Companies
   (All Form Factors).
2. Know-how licensing and Turn-key solutions to Pilot and Commerical scale manufacturing of Li-CAMs
   (LFP,LFMP, NMC, LCO and LMO) manufacturing.
3. Know-how licensing and Turn-key Solution to LIB non-aqueous LiPF6 and LiFSI Liquid Electrolyte
   Formulation and additiv

* Jaytee Alloys & Components Limited
  
  ## Become The Leading Producer Of Various
  ## Stainless Steel And Aluminium Pressure Cooker Parts
  
  [Contact Us][241]

## About us

We use all kinds of rare earth non ferrous metals like INDIUM, GALLIUM, TIN, BISMUTH, LEAD, ZINC,
ALUMINIUM, COPPER etc., for manufacturing of various high performance alloys. We also specialize in
manufacturing of fusible alloys and low temperature alloys. We are one of the largest manufactures

# About Us

Company Profile

KABIT GLOBAL NEW ENERGY is a global battery swap solution provider, offering **integrated systems
that connect vehicles, batteries, swap cabinets, apps, and cloud platforms**—enabling efficient
energy supply and driving the electrification of global transportation.

KABIT GLOBAL NEW ENERGY is also the leader in high-performance battery systems, specializing in
advanced energy solutions for industrial** UAVs, robotics, and energy storage** (ESS). Leveraging 20
years of expertise and 110+ patents, we integrate **high energy density semi-solid-state
technology** with deep **BMS** optimization to deliver unmatched safety and energy density.

Operating six intelligent manufacturing bases, we provide end-to-end services from cell** R&D** to
global engineering implementation. Committed to the “Sustainable, responsible, and circular battery
value chain” goals, KABIT GLOBAL drives the transition to sustainable energy through
“Standardization & Customization” and transparent, automated production—ensuring high-performance
power for the world’s most demanding applications.

Mission

## We exist because
## power matters.

Power is the key
to successful deployment of
Physical and Edge AI.

Physical AI sits at the intersection of three disciplines: artificial intelligence gives machines
perception and decision-making; energy storage gives them mobility and endurance; power electronics
converts that energy into reliable motion, compute, and control. Every drone, edge system, and
autonomous platform runs on electricity — and that electricity must be dense, reliable, and
available wherever the mission demands.

KULR operates at the integration layer where those disciplines come together. We manufacture
batteries, BMS, chargers, and power electronics domestically — not because it is easier, but because
supply chain integrity, national energy security, and job creation are inseparable from the mission.
The companies that integrate across these disciplines will define the next decade of physical
infrastructure. **We intend to be one of them.**

FORGE-2 is KULR's high-volume manufacturing facility — running automated and semi-automated

up to 50 MWh of Telecom and Grid Storage systems.

[KULR facility exterior]
Supply Chain

## NDAA-compliant batteries,
## start to finish.

A battery supply chain built for defense and government requirements. Every cell, component, and
finished pack is sourced, manufactured, and assembled domestically — with full NDAA Section 889 and
1260H documentation at every step.

01
NDAA-Compliant
Cell Sourcing
Cells sourced exclusively from qualified domestic and allied-nation suppliers with no ties to
prohibited foreign entities under NDAA Section 1260H. Country-of-origin documentation and
restricted-entity checks maintained for every lot entering the line.
02
Domestic Battery
Manufacturing
End-to-end battery pack production in the United States — from cell intake through pack integration
— on automated lines with inline quality checks at every stage. No offshore subassembly, no
foreign-entity dependencies.
03
Proprietary
In-House Welding
Proprietary laser and resistance welding processes developed and executed domestically, validated to
a >50 lb pull-test standard. Every weld joint is logged and traceable to operator, machine, and
production lot — with no dependency on foreign subcontractors.
04
In-House Battery
Testing
Thermal cycling, abuse tolerance, and multi-physics simulation performed on-site against MIL-SPEC
and UL standards. Each battery design is stress-tested across operating envelopes before release —
no reliance on foreign or third-party labs for core validation.
05
Domestic Pack
Assembly
Final battery system assembly executed in a controlled, U.S.-based facility with electrostatic and
contamination controls. Functional test, capacity verification, and burn-in completed before
shipment — fully traceable for government end-use requirements.
06
Quality &
NDAA Documentation
AS9100 certified quality management system with full NDAA-compliant documentation packages.
Country-of-origin records, restricted-entity clearances, and manufacturing lot traceability retained
for every battery system we ship.
07
Scalable Defense
Production
Production architecture built for program ramps and surge requirements — not prototypes. Modular
line configuration supports rapid battery capacity expansion to meet government contract timelines
without compromising yield, quality, or NDAA compliance.

Mission

## We exist because
## power matters.

Power is the key
to successful deployment of
Physical and Edge AI.

Physical AI sits at the intersection of three disciplines: artificial intelligence gives machines
perception and decision-making; energy storage gives them mobility and endurance; power electronics
converts that energy into reliable motion, compute, and control. Every drone, edge system, and
autonomous platform runs on electricity — and that electricity must be dense, reliable, and
available wherever the mission demands.

KULR operates at the integration layer where those disciplines come together. We manufacture
batteries, BMS, chargers, and power electronics domestically — not because it is easier, but because
supply chain integrity, national energy security, and job creation are inseparable from the mission.
The companies that integrate across these disciplines will define the next decade of physical
infrastructure. **We intend to be one of them.**
