## NDAA-compliant batteries,
## start to finish.

A battery supply chain built for defense and government requirements. Every cell, component, and
finished pack is sourced, manufactured, and assembled domestically — with full NDAA Section 889 and
1260H documentation at every step.

01
NDAA-Compliant
Cell Sourcing
Cells sourced exclusively from qualified domestic and allied-nation suppliers with no ties to
prohibited foreign entities under NDAA Section 1260H. Country-of-origin documentation and
restricted-entity checks maintained for every lot entering the line.
02
Domestic Battery
Manufacturing
End-to-end battery pack production in the United States — from cell intake through pack integration
— on automated lines with inline quality checks at every stage. No offshore subassembly, no
foreign-entity dependencies.
03
Proprietary
In-House Welding
Proprietary laser and resistance welding processes developed and executed domestically, validated to
a >50 lb pull-test standard. Every weld joint is logged and traceable to operator, machine, and
production lot — with no dependency on foreign subcontractors.
04
In-House Battery
Testing
Thermal cycling, abuse tolerance, and multi-physics simulation performed on-site against MIL-SPEC
and UL standards. Each battery design is stress-tested across operating envelopes before release —
no reliance on foreign or third-party labs for core validation.
05
Domestic Pack
Assembly
Final battery system assembly executed in a controlled, U.S.-based facility with electrostatic and
contamination controls. Functional test, capacity verification, and burn-in completed before
shipment — fully traceable for government end-use requirements.
06
Quality &
NDAA Documentation
AS9100 certified quality management system with full NDAA-compliant documentation packages.
Country-of-origin records, restricted-entity clearances, and manufacturing lot traceability retained
for every battery system we ship.
07
Scalable Defense
Production
Production architecture built for program ramps and surge requirements — not prototypes. Modular
line configuration supports rapid battery capacity expansion to meet government contract timelines
without compromising yield, quality, or NDAA compliance.

energy solutions**—powering homes, businesses, and communities with **dependable power backup and
solar energy systems** across India.

engineered to deliver consistent performance for diverse energy needs.

At Leader Batteries, **we don’t just manufacture products—we deliver peace of mind.** Every solution
is the result of years of **research, precision engineering, and stringent quality control**,
supported by a **nationwide service network** ensuring uninterrupted performance and customer
satisfaction.

cutting-edge technology, and uncompromising quality standards**, setting benchmarks not only in
India but across global markets.

Our success is powered by a **strong, skilled, and dedicated workforce**, united by a shared
commitment to **innovation, excellence, and progress**. Every day, we strive to exceed
expectations—continuously improving, learning, and evolving to meet the dynamic needs of the future.

Integrity lies at the heart of our philosophy. We engage with our partners and clients with
**honesty, transparency, and accountability**, ensuring that every relationship we build is grounded
in trust. Guided by **self-reflection, patience, and dedication**, we move forward with
confidence—driven by a mission to be the **most trusted name in energy solutions**.

Behind every Leader success story is a **robust marketing and distribution network** led by industry
experts, market leaders, and professionals who ensure that our **products and services consistently
deliver performance, reliability, and value**.

Headquartered in **Sultanpur**, **Delhi** with a state-of-the-art **manufacturing plant in
Pantnagar, Uttarakhand**, Leader’s plant stands as a testament to our **technological advancement

engineering in action**.

## Empowering Lives with High Performance batteries & Solar Solutions

For over five decades, **Leader Batteries** has been a trusted force in **innovative and sustainable
energy solutions**—powering homes, businesses, and communities with **dependable power backup and
solar energy systems** across India.

With **deep manufacturing expertise** and a **legacy built on trust and quality**, Leader Batteries
stands at the forefront of **energy storage innovation**. Our comprehensive product portfolio spans
 **Tubular – Inverter , Solar Batteries & Solar Off-Grid **and **E-Rickshaw Batteries**—each
engineered to deliver consistent performance for diverse energy needs.

At Leader Batteries, **we don’t just manufacture products—we deliver peace of mind.** Every solution
is the result of years of **research, precision engineering, and stringent quality control**,
supported by a **nationwide service network** ensuring uninterrupted performance and customer
satisfaction.

### Why Leader Batteries Stands Apart :-
### [🌱] **Eco-friendly & Future-ready Solutions** – Power that respects the planet.
### [⚡] **Reliable Energy, Round the Clock** – Because power shouldn’t stop when life goes on.
### [🔋] **Advanced Tubular & Solar Technologies** – Engineered for endurance and efficiency.
### [🕒] **Manufacturing Trust. Delivering Performance.** – Transparent, tested, and trusted
### performance.

 

## Engineering Excellence, Built on Trust and Integrity

At **Leader Batteries**, quality is not an afterthought—it’s **embedded in every step of our
process**, right from design to delivery. Each product is crafted with **precision engineering,
cutting-edge technology, and uncompromising quality standards**, setting benchmarks not only in
India but across global markets.

Our success is powered by a **strong, skilled, and dedicated workforce**, united by a shared
commitment to **innovation, excellence, and progress**. Every day, we strive to exceed
expectations—continuously improving, learning, and evolving to meet the dynamic needs of the future.

Integrity lies at the heart of our philosophy. We engage with our partners and clients with
**honesty, transparency, and accountability**, ensuring that every relationship we build is grounded
in trust. Guided by **self-reflection, patience, and dedication**, we move forward with
confidence—driven by a mission to be the **most trusted name in energy solutions**.

Behind every Leader success story is a **robust marketing and distribution network** led by industry
experts, market leaders, and professionals who ensure that our **products and services consistently
deliver performance, reliability, and value**.

Headquartered in **Sultanpur**, **Delhi** with a state-of-the-art **manufacturing plant in
Pantnagar, Uttarakhand**, Leader’s plant stands as a testament to our **technological advancement
and production excellence**—a must-visit destination for anyone who wishes to witness **modern
engineering in action**.

## India's Leading Battery Manufacturer

### Leader has been a symbol of trust and quality for years making it a pioneer in the battery
### industry.

# [Analytical Industry INNOVATION Since 1936][58]

[Request a Quote][59]

**We take away the stress and frustration your laboratory experiences when faced with the increasing
demands of doing more with less.**

The one thing all laboratories need to be successful is results they feel confident in. Since 1936,
millions of samples worldwide have been analyzed using LECO laboratory instruments for elemental
analysis, thermal analysis, metallography, and mass spectrometry. Our comprehensive solutions for
improving productivity include working with you to find the right equipment for the type of analysis
you are doing — and providing you with the training, application support, and service you need to
keep your lab running at its best.

Protection Features

## Built-in Protection, Standard

Every Lithion Power BMS ships with a full suite of cell protection features.

🛡️

#### Overcharge Protection

Cuts charging current when cell voltage exceeds the safe upper threshold. Prevents thermal runaway
and electrolyte decomposition.

⬇️

#### Over-Discharge Protection

Disconnects the load before cells reach the minimum safe voltage. Preserves capacity and extends
cycle life.

⚡

#### Short-Circuit Protection

Instantaneous shutdown on output short. Self-resetting after fault clearance on most models.

🌡️

#### Temperature Monitoring

Onboard NTC sensor monitors cell temperature. Charging and discharging suspended outside safe range
(−10 °C to 70 °C).

⚖️

#### Cell Balancing

Passive balancing on Non-Smart range; active balancing on Smart BMS. Keeps all cells within 10–20 mV
of each other.

📊

#### SOC / SOH Tracking

Smart BMS models report real-time State of Charge and State of Health over CAN, UART or RS485 to the
host controller.

FAQ

## Common Questions

Everything you need to know before placing an order.

#### What is the minimum order quantity?

MOQ is 100 pieces for most standard BMS models. For Smart BMS the MOQ is lower — contact us for
details. Samples are available for evaluation prior to bulk orders.

#### Do you offer custom BMS design?

Yes. Our in-house R&D team can design custom BMS for your specific voltage, current rating and form
factor requirements. Share your specifications and we'll quote you.

Protection Features

## Built-in Protection, Standard

Every Lithion Power BMS ships with a full suite of cell protection features.

🛡️

#### Overcharge Protection

Cuts charging current when cell voltage exceeds the safe upper threshold. Prevents thermal runaway
and electrolyte decomposition.

⬇️

#### Over-Discharge Protection

Disconnects the load before cells reach the minimum safe voltage. Preserves capacity and extends
cycle life.

⚡

#### Short-Circuit Protection

Instantaneous shutdown on output short. Self-resetting after fault clearance on most models.

🌡️

#### Temperature Monitoring

Onboard NTC sensor monitors cell temperature. Charging and discharging suspended outside safe range
(−10 °C to 70 °C).

⚖️

#### Cell Balancing

Passive balancing on Non-Smart range; active balancing on Smart BMS. Keeps all cells within 10–20 mV
of each other.

📊

#### SOC / SOH Tracking

Smart BMS models report real-time State of Charge and State of Health over CAN, UART or RS485 to the
host controller.

## Who We Are

Founded in 1978, the Mortex Group specializes in production & exports of Bulk Ferro Alloys, keeping
the focus on Manganese, Chrome and Si based alloys.

Committed to growing and expanding in ways that support customers’ needs, we have successfully
established ourselves as a major name in the field of Ferro Alloys, with a market presence in 6 of
the 7 continents of the world.

We aim at customer satisfaction by meeting our customers’ needs with precisely the right solutions
by efficiently understanding intricate and diverse customer needs. We meet these challenges by
extending high-quality products, competitive pricing, on-time shipment, ensuring maximum commitment
and dedication from our side.

## Our Products

## Silico Manganese

Widely used in the steel manufacturing process as an allowing agent, Silico Manganese offers the
necessary hardness and toughness and therefore, is an integral element of the steel making process

[ EXPLORE ][46]

## Ferro Manganese

Used in producing steel as well as foundry products, Ferro Manganese imparts metallurgical
characteristics like increased strength, toughness and hardness to the final product

[ EXPLORE ][47]

## Ferro Chrome

As a main ingredient used for producing stainless steel, Ferro Chrome delivers shinning appearance
and corrosion resistance. It is also used in the metallurgical industry, chemical industry and
refractory & foundry industry

[ EXPLORE ][48]

## Ferro Silicon

Used as a silicon source, Ferro Silicon aids in deoxidizing steel and other alloys so that carbon
loss can be prevented from the molten steel. It is also used for prealloy and cast iron
manufacturing

## Who We Are

Founded in 1978, the Mortex Group specializes in production & exports of Bulk Ferro Alloys, keeping
the focus on Manganese, Chrome and Si based alloys.

Committed to growing and expanding in ways that support customers’ needs, we have successfully
established ourselves as a major name in the field of Ferro Alloys, with a market presence in 6 of
the 7 continents of the world.

We aim at customer satisfaction by meeting our customers’ needs with precisely the right solutions
by efficiently understanding intricate and diverse customer needs. We meet these challenges by
extending high-quality products, competitive pricing, on-time shipment, ensuring maximum commitment
and dedication from our side.

## Our Products

## Silico Manganese

Widely used in the steel manufacturing process as an allowing agent, Silico Manganese offers the
necessary hardness and toughness and therefore, is an integral element of the steel making process

[ EXPLORE ][46]

## Ferro Manganese

Used in producing steel as well as foundry products, Ferro Manganese imparts metallurgical
characteristics like increased strength, toughness and hardness to the final product

[ EXPLORE ][47]

## Ferro Chrome

As a main ingredient used for producing stainless steel, Ferro Chrome delivers shinning appearance
and corrosion resistance. It is also used in the metallurgical industry, chemical industry and
refractory & foundry industry

[ EXPLORE ][48]

## Ferro Silicon

Used as a silicon source, Ferro Silicon aids in deoxidizing steel and other alloys so that carbon
loss can be prevented from the molten steel. It is also used for prealloy and cast iron
manufacturing

What is ExpiredDomains.com?
ExpiredDomains.com is a free online platform that helps users find valuable expired and expiring
domain names. It aggregates domain data from hundreds of top-level domains (TLDs) and displays them
in a searchable, filterable format. Whether you’re seeking domains with SEO authority, existing
traffic, or strong brand potential, the platform provides tools and insights to support smarter
decisions.
Is there a cost to use the platform?
No, the platform is completely free to use. You can browse listings, view metrics, and apply filters
without needing to sign up or pay any fees. There are no hidden charges or usage restrictions.
Can I register domains directly through the site?
No, ExpiredDomains.com does not register domains itself. Instead, it connects you to trusted
external registrars and marketplaces like GoDaddy. You’ll be directed to complete your purchase or
place a bid through their platform.
How often is the domain data updated?
The domain data is updated daily to ensure you're always seeing the most current listings, prices,
and metrics. This includes newly expired domains, auction updates, and fresh insights from
third-party tools and proprietary systems.
What tools and filters are available on the platform?
You can filter domains by TLD, keyword, length, backlink profile, SEO score, traffic estimates, and
more. The platform also includes proprietary metrics like Estimated Auction Price, BrandRank, and
SEO Price, alongside trusted data from sources like MOZ and Majestic.

## The NEB Story

Since 1985, **Northeast Battery** has built an operationally driven distribution business focused on
uptime. We support commercial fleets, industrial operations, and specialty applications with the
right inventory, fast fulfillment, and teams that understand how power systems perform in the field.

As the flagship company within **Stored Energy Holdings Inc. (SEHI)**, NEB combines local execution
with network scale—expanded product access, coordinated logistics, and consistent service standards
across locations.

Established
1985
Focus
Commercial & Industrial
Model
Multi-Location Distribution

### Operational Services
* **Weekly deliveries:** predictable replenishment with fresh stock (no minimums).
* **Stock rotations:** we audit shelf inventory and rotate aged units out.
* **Scrap backhaul & recycling:** we remove used batteries and manage core handling.
* **Battery specialists on call:** fast answers for spec, application, and ordering.
* **Quality-assured supply:** leading brands with strong warranty support.

[Become a Customer][47][Find a Location][48]

Long-term relationships matter here. Many of our customers have worked with NEB for decades— a
reflection of consistent execution and accountability.

### North-American Design & Manufacturing

manufacturing located in Canada.

[ Learn More  about North-American Design & Manufacturing ][43]

## Stem and Nuvation Energy Enter into Agreement to Deliver North American-Made BESS Control
## Solution

As demand for secure, compliant energy infrastructure accelerates, developers are looking for
solutions that deliver both performance and transparency from the ground up. This announcement
highlights a new collaboration between Stem, Inc. and Nuvation Energy, combining PowerTrack™ EMS
with Nuvation’s BMS to deliver a fully North American-made control solution.

[ LEARN MORE  about Stem and Nuvation Energy Enter into Agreement to Deliver North American-Made
BESS Control Solution ][44]

## Webinar: Grid Security in Battery Energy Storage and Power Resiliency Applications

Join Michael Worry, CEO & CTO of Nuvation Energy, and James Richmond, CEO & Founder of e2Companies
for an exploration of how energy storage system integrators are delivering solutions that balance
domestic sourcing requirements against global supply chain dependencies.

[ WATCH NOW  about Webinar: Grid Security in Battery Energy Storage and Power Resiliency
Applications ][45]

## Honeywell Collaborates with Nuvation Energy to Add Flexible Battery Management System to
## Honeywell Ionic™

Honeywell today announced its collaboration with Nuvation Energy to integrate an improved battery
management system (BMS) into Honeywell’s modular battery energy storage system, Honeywell Ionic™.

[ LEARN MORE  about Honeywell Collaborates with Nuvation Energy to Add Flexible Battery Management
System to Honeywell Ionic™ ][46]

## Field-Proven Energy Storage Deployments Worldwide

Nuvation Energy solutions have been deployed in energy storage projects around the world, supporting
applications ranging from utility-scale grid infrastructure to marine, aerospace, and defense
systems.

[View All Projects][47]

design services.

requirements.

aircraft and naval vessels.

### North-American Design & Manufacturing

Nuvation Energy’s engineering and design operations are fully in the USA and Canada, with
manufacturing located in Canada.

[ Learn More  about North-American Design & Manufacturing ][43]

## Solution

As demand for secure, compliant energy infrastructure accelerates, developers are looking for
solutions that deliver both performance and transparency from the ground up. This announcement
highlights a new collaboration between Stem, Inc. and Nuvation Energy, combining PowerTrack™ EMS
with Nuvation’s BMS to deliver a fully North American-made control solution.

[ LEARN MORE  about Stem and Nuvation Energy Enter into Agreement to Deliver North American-Made
BESS Control Solution ][44]

Join Michael Worry, CEO & CTO of Nuvation Energy, and James Richmond, CEO & Founder of e2Companies
for an exploration of how energy storage system integrators are delivering solutions that balance
domestic sourcing requirements against global supply chain dependencies.

[ WATCH NOW  about Webinar: Grid Security in Battery Energy Storage and Power Resiliency
Applications ][45]

## Honeywell Ionic™

Honeywell today announced its collaboration with Nuvation Energy to integrate an improved battery
management system (BMS) into Honeywell’s modular battery energy storage system, Honeywell Ionic™.

System to Honeywell Ionic™ ][46]

ABOUT PILOT

# Leading manufacturer of Refined Lead(Pure Lead), Lead Alloys and Lead Acid Batteries

For over Four decades now, the name Pilot Industries Ltd. has become synonymous with the best
Battery (Brand “Leader”), Battery Plates, Lead and Lead Alloys. Over the years it has stood-up for
exceptionally high standards of quality and utmost reliability, with its convictions for delivering
truly world class products. Pilot Industries Limited was started by the visionary Shri Dwarka Prasad
Agarwal (Chairman) at a young age after completing his graduation from Kolkata, in the year 1969.

### We Manufacture:

## 1. Pure Lead 99.97% to 99.985%

Pilot is a leading pure lead ingots manufacturer in India. Our Pure Lead Ingot is being produced
from Remelted lead,  Lead Scraps, and Secondary Lead Ingots though Pyrometallurgical process. All
our Lead products are supplied with Spectrophotometer test reports.

## 2. Lead Alloys

We are manufacturing facilities for lead alloys. Our lead alloys manufacturing plant is located in
Bhiwadi Rajasthan and Pant Nagar Uttrakhand. We create lead-antimony alloys, lead-tin alloys, lead
copper alloys, lead cadmium alloys, lead selenium alloys and other alloys as per the requirement of
the customer.

Battery (Brand “Leader”), Battery Plates, Lead and Lead Alloys. Over the years it has stood-up for
exceptionally high standards of quality and utmost reliability, with its convictions for delivering

We are manufacturing facilities for lead alloys. Our lead alloys manufacturing plant is located in

# ASME Code Fabricator &
# Corrosion-Resistant Alloy Distributor

RAM Industries, a Division of TITAN Metal Fabricators, Inc.,  is a fabrication company specializing
in alloy and premium metals in corrosive and heat-resistant applications. We provide design and
fabrication services for process equipment, pressure vessels and piping for the oil & gas, refining,
petrochemical, pulp & paper and water treatment industries. We hold an ASME “U” stamp as well as
NBIC “R” stamp which enables us to perform code fabrication and repairs both in our shop and field
locations.

RAM Industries fabricates pre-engineered OEM designed equipment and systems as well as highly
corrosion-resistant process equipment for any industry that has corrosion problems, including:
* Chemical
* Petrochemical
* Oil & Gas Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG)
* Pharmaceutical
* Steel Industry
* Energy
* Geothermal
* Biomass
* Nuclear Power
* Solar Power Facilities
* Metal Finishing, Plating & Anodizing
* Mining
* Water Desalination

### RAM equipment can be found anywhere corrosion is a problem to be solved.

Our primary business focus is on fast turn around, pre-engineered build to print products, pressure
vessels, piping, column sections, ducts, and miscellaneous fabrications.

RAM specializes in the fabrication of the following corrosion-resistant alloys:
* Austenitic Stainless Steels
* Lean Duplex Stainless Steel
* Super Duplex Stainless Steel
* Duplex Stainless Steel
* Nickel
* High Nickel Alloys
* Inconel^{®}
* Monel^{®}
* Hastelloy^{®}
* Titanium
* Zirconium

Monel and Inconel are registered trademarks of [Special Metals Corporation][58].
Hastelloy is a registered trademark of [Haynes International, Inc][59].

RAM has decades of fabrication experience in high nickel and reactive metal welding that promises a
high-quality product every time.

### RAM Manufacturing Capacities:
* Diameter: 16 Feet (5 Meters)
* Length: 50 Feet (15 Meters)
* Weight: 20 Tons US (20t)
* Pressure: 2500 psig (170 Bar)
* Temperature: 1200º F (650º C)

### Industry Certifications, Design Codes and Standards:

RAM manufactures pressure equipment in accordance ASME Section VIII Division 1. Welding is per ASME
Section IX.
* ASME
* API
* ASTM
* AWS

### TITAN Technical Resources

You’ll find product information, reactive metals information, corrosion charts, calculators and much
more in TITAN’s **[Technical Resources Center][60]**.

### Questions?

RAM would be pleased to work with you to resolve any of your project concerns. Our experienced team,
together with leading metallurgists and major specialists, is extremely capable of resolving your
most challenging corrosion, application, mechanical design challenges. Download a copy of our
brochure [**here**][61].

RAM Industries, a Division of TITAN Metal Fabricators, Inc.,  is a fabrication company specializing
in alloy and premium metals in corrosive and heat-resistant applications. We provide design and
fabrication services for process equipment, pressure vessels and piping for the oil & gas, refining,
petrochemical, pulp & paper and water treatment industries. We hold an ASME “U” stamp as well as
NBIC “R” stamp which enables us to perform code fabrication and repairs both in our shop and field
locations.

RAM Industries fabricates pre-engineered OEM designed equipment and systems as well as highly
corrosion-resistant process equipment for any industry that has corrosion problems, including:
* Chemical
* Petrochemical
* Oil & Gas Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG)
* Pharmaceutical
* Steel Industry
* Energy
* Geothermal
* Biomass
* Nuclear Power
* Solar Power Facilities
* Metal Finishing, Plating & Anodizing
* Mining
* Water Desalination

### RAM equipment can be found anywhere corrosion is a problem to be solved.

Our primary business focus is on fast turn around, pre-engineered build to print products, pressure
vessels, piping, column sections, ducts, and miscellaneous fabrications.

RAM specializes in the fabrication of the following corrosion-resistant alloys:
* Austenitic Stainless Steels
* Lean Duplex Stainless Steel
* Super Duplex Stainless Steel
* Duplex Stainless Steel
* Nickel
* High Nickel Alloys
* Inconel^{®}
* Monel^{®}
* Hastelloy^{®}
* Titanium
* Zirconium

Monel and Inconel are registered trademarks of [Special Metals Corporation][58].

high-quality product every time.

Offer custom battery systems for commercial vehicles, including buses, trucks, construction

#### FAQ Of Customer

What products does Rikayaa specialize in?

Rikayaa specializes in the manufacturing of high-purity non-ferrous metals, particularly Tin Ingots
with a minimum purity of 99.90%.

Where can I purchase Rikayaa products?

Our products are available directly through our corporate sales team. For larger or custom orders,
please contact our sales department directly.

What sets Rikayaa apart in the non-ferrous metals industry?

Rikayaa is known for its commitment to quality and innovation. We are pioneers in refining processes
to produce 99.90% pure Tin from scrap, ensuring superior quality and environmental responsibility.

Does Rikayaa have any certifications or quality assurances?

Yes, Rikayaa adheres to strict quality standards and holds ISO 9001:2015, ISO 22000:2018 & ISO
14001:2015 certifications, ensuring that our products meet the highest international standards for
quality and safety.

Can Rikayaa provide material safety data sheets (MSDS) for its products?

Absolutely. Safety data sheets for all our products are available upon request. These documents
provide safety handling, storage, and disposal information to ensure safe usage.

What research and development initiatives does Rikayaa undertake?

Rikayaa is actively involved in R&D focused on new product development and refining processes for
non-ferrous metals. Our efforts are geared towards enhancing product quality and developing new
applications for our metals.

How does Rikayaa support environmental sustainability?

Our commitment to sustainability is reflected in our advanced refining processes that maximize
resource efficiency and reduce waste. We are dedicated to complying with environmental regulations
and promoting responsible manufacturing practices.

What is the minimum order quantity for Rikayaa products?

The minimum order quantity can vary depending on the product and its specifications. For detailed
information, please contact our sales team.

How can I get technical support or advice on using Rikayaa products?

Our technical support team is available to provide comprehensive assistance and advice on the best
use of our products for your specific applications. You can reach out to them via email, phone, or
through our website.

#### FAQ Of Customer

What products does Rikayaa specialize in?

Rikayaa specializes in the manufacturing of high-purity non-ferrous metals, particularly Tin Ingots
with a minimum purity of 99.90%.

Where can I purchase Rikayaa products?

Our products are available directly through our corporate sales team. For larger or custom orders,
please contact our sales department directly.

What sets Rikayaa apart in the non-ferrous metals industry?

Rikayaa is known for its commitment to quality and innovation. We are pioneers in refining processes
to produce 99.90% pure Tin from scrap, ensuring superior quality and environmental responsibility.

Does Rikayaa have any certifications or quality assurances?

Yes, Rikayaa adheres to strict quality standards and holds ISO 9001:2015, ISO 22000:2018 & ISO
14001:2015 certifications, ensuring that our products meet the highest international standards for
quality and safety.

Can Rikayaa provide material safety data sheets (MSDS) for its products?

Absolutely. Safety data sheets for all our products are available upon request. These documents
provide safety handling, storage, and disposal information to ensure safe usage.

What research and development initiatives does Rikayaa undertake?

Rikayaa is actively involved in R&D focused on new product development and refining processes for
non-ferrous metals. Our efforts are geared towards enhancing product quality and developing new
applications for our metals.

How does Rikayaa support environmental sustainability?

Our commitment to sustainability is reflected in our advanced refining processes that maximize
resource efficiency and reduce waste. We are dedicated to complying with environmental regulations
and promoting responsible manufacturing practices.

What is the minimum order quantity for Rikayaa products?

The minimum order quantity can vary depending on the product and its specifications. For detailed
information, please contact our sales team.

How can I get technical support or advice on using Rikayaa products?

Our technical support team is available to provide comprehensive assistance and advice on the best
use of our products for your specific applications. You can reach out to them via email, phone, or
through our website.

battery management. Its AI-enhanced high energy density and high power density Li-Metal and Li-ion

These batteries can be used for transportation on land and in the air, storage, robotics, drones,

## Testimonials

Kent Helfrich
CTO and VP R&D, General Motors President, GM Ventures

“It’s all about cost and range and charging. And we think the SES technology delivers on all of
those promises.”

Yoshiya Josh Fujiwara
Expert engineer, Honda R&D

“Let’s communicate closely in the common language of technology and be the first in the world to
bring the Li-Metal battery to the automobile market.”

Chang Hwan Kim
Senior Vice President, Head of Electrification Energy Solutions Tech Unit at Hyundai Motor and Kia

“This technology will definitely become part of the enabling technology for our future product,
giving tremendous benefit to our customers.”

Dr. Shirley Meng
Professor, University of Chicago; Chief Scientist for Energy Storage Science at Argonne National
Laboratory

“SES’s data set in terms of temperature operation range and also the weight capability even exceeded
our expectations.”

## About SES AI

SES AI’s mission is to accelerate the world’s energy transition through material discovery and
battery management. Its AI-enhanced high energy density and high power density Li-Metal and Li-ion
batteries are the first batteries in the world to contain electrolyte materials discovered by AI.
These batteries can be used for transportation on land and in the air, storage, robotics, drones,
and many other applications.

## SHARIF METALS GROUP
## RECYCLING THE MIDDLE EAST.

Sharif Metals Group, a family owned company, founded in 1963

Sharif Metals Group (SMG) is a family-owned company, founded in 1963. Developed to be the leading
recycling group in the Middle East and North Africa. SMG IS accredited with ISO 9001:2015. Recycling
all ranges of ferrous and non-ferrous metals, mainly Copper, Aluminium, Zinc, and Nickel alloys.
Renowned and approved producers of secondary Aluminium and Lead Alloys. Sharif Metals Group is
currently run by the fourth-generation management team, who have bottom-top field experience since a
young age, topped with high academic education, bridging the old school of the founder, with modern
technology and digitalized platform I.e. new school. Passing the legacy from grandfather to
grandsons. Sharif Metals Group is striving to meet the circular economy’s objectives, in
transforming EOL material into vital raw materials. Preserving natural resources, reducing Carbon
emissions, and creating job opportunities, to ensure environmental and Socioeconomic Sustainability.

# Distributeur / Stockiste
# Alliages métalliques à hautes performances et services associés

[Voir la vidéo][79]

Depuis plus de 90 ans, STAINLESS s’est imposé comme un acteur de référence dans les aciers
inoxydables et les alliages hautes performances. Agent d’usine et distributeur-stockiste, **nous
accompagnons les industriels les plus exigeants en leur apportant bien plus que des matériaux : la
sécurisation de leurs approvisionnements critiques.**

Dans les secteurs du Médical, de l’Aéronautique, des Microtechniques et de la Défense, nous
répondons à une exigence centrale : garantir des matériaux fiables, traçables et disponibles au bon
moment, avec un accompagnement technique et logistique de haut niveau.

Notre valeur repose sur une combinaison d’expertises intégrées :
* #### **une maîtrise métallurgique approfondie**
* #### **un laboratoire interne de contrôle qualité et d’analyses**
* #### **un réseau de producteurs partenaires de long terme**
* #### **une logistique internationale agile.**

Cette organisation nous permet de proposer une offre globale sécurisée, adaptée aux environnements
industriels les plus exigeants.
Notre large gamme de produits, barres, tubes, feuillards, tôles, est distribuée à l’échelle mondiale
et répond aux standards des industries à forte valeur technologique.

STAINLESS s’appuie sur les normes internationales les plus strictes et des certifications reconnues,
garantissant notre engagement constant en matière de qualité, de sécurité et d’environnement.

**Proches de nos clients, nous nous engageons à réduire les risques d’approvisionnement et à
soutenir les innovations industrielles les plus ambitieuses**

[En savoir plus][98]

pièces critiques qui nécessitent une résistance à la chaleur, une résistance à la corrosion, un gain
de poids, une plus grande solidité ou une résistance à la fatigue : **Titane et alliages de
Titane**, **Aciers inoxydables**, **Alliages base nickel et base cuivre**, aciers spéciaux.

[En savoir plus][99]

alliages hautes performances et barres d’aciers inoxydables.

[En savoir plus][100]

la Plaisance ou de l’Automobile. Un stock adapté à chaque secteur avec de nombreuses nuances en
**Titane Industriel, CuBe, ToughMet®, Aciers inxydables,  Aciers pou outils, Inconels, Nimonic 90…**

[En savoir plus][101]

Électronique, Automobile, Aéronautique, Médical, Horlogerie… en proposant des petits diamètres et
des feuillards très minces – jusqu’à 5 µm. Sa capacité de refendage lui donne un atout décisif. La
gamme s’étend du **cuivre-béryllium** aux **superalliages**, des **titanes et alliages** au
**ToughMet®** en passant par de nombreuses autres nuances.

[En savoir plus][102]

**poudres métalliques** à destination des marchés les plus exigeants (Aéronautique, médicale, 
Microtechniques ou encore de l’industrie).

Des **poudres fines en Titane**, **Aciers inoxydables**, **base cobalt**, **base cuivre**.

# Distributeur / Stockiste
# Alliages métalliques à hautes performances et services associés

[Voir la vidéo][79]

Depuis plus de 90 ans, STAINLESS s’est imposé comme un acteur de référence dans les aciers
inoxydables et les alliages hautes performances. Agent d’usine et distributeur-stockiste, **nous
accompagnons les industriels les plus exigeants en leur apportant bien plus que des matériaux : la
sécurisation de leurs approvisionnements critiques.**

Dans les secteurs du Médical, de l’Aéronautique, des Microtechniques et de la Défense, nous
répondons à une exigence centrale : garantir des matériaux fiables, traçables et disponibles au bon
moment, avec un accompagnement technique et logistique de haut niveau.

Notre valeur repose sur une combinaison d’expertises intégrées :
* #### **une maîtrise métallurgique approfondie**
* #### **un laboratoire interne de contrôle qualité et d’analyses**
* #### **un réseau de producteurs partenaires de long terme**
* #### **une logistique internationale agile.**

Cette organisation nous permet de proposer une offre globale sécurisée, adaptée aux environnements
industriels les plus exigeants.
Notre large gamme de produits, barres, tubes, feuillards, tôles, est distribuée à l’échelle mondiale
et répond aux standards des industries à forte valeur technologique.

STAINLESS s’appuie sur les normes internationales les plus strictes et des certifications reconnues,
garantissant notre engagement constant en matière de qualité, de sécurité et d’environnement.

**Proches de nos clients, nous nous engageons à réduire les risques d’approvisionnement et à
soutenir les innovations industrielles les plus ambitieuses**

[En savoir plus][80]

confiance à STAINLESS France pour les accompagner à relever leurs défis d’aujourd’hui et de demain.

STAINLESS propose une gamme complète de matériaux métalliques biocompatibles répondants aux normes
internationales, pour la fabrication de vos implants, prothèses, ancillaires et instrumentations.
Un stock adapté avec notamment les nuances en [Aciers inoxydables][93], [Alliages base Cobalt][94],
[Titane et alliages de Titane][95].

[En savoir plus][96]

Depuis les années 50, les principaux avionneurs civils ou militaires, et leurs équipementiers,
accordent leur confiance à STAINLESS. Les matériaux fournis des **alliages cuivreux** (le CuBe2 et
le ToughMet® en particulier) , des alliages spéciaux, ainsi que des barres d’**aciers inoxydables**
qui **répondent aux normes aéronautiques et aux spécifications les plus sévères**.

[En savoir plus][97]

Stainless fournit le marché de l’énergie (PÉTROLE ET GAZ, BATTERIE, NUCLÉAIRE, ÉLECTRICITÉ ) avec
des barres en **aciers hautes performances, superalliages, titane et des poudres métalliques.**

[En savoir plus][98]

Stainless fournit une gamme complète de matériaux métalliques de hautes performances pour toutes vos
pièces critiques qui nécessitent une résistance à la chaleur, une résistance à la corrosion, un gain
de poids, une plus grande solidité ou une résistance à la fatigue : **Titane et alliages de
Titane**, **Aciers inoxydables**, **Alliages base nickel et base cuivre**, aciers spéciaux.

[En savoir plus][99]

STAINLESS  propose des **alliages de hautes performances pour le marché de la défense**. Nous sommes
en capacité de devenir votre fournisseur privilégié. Nous fournissons une gamme essentielle de
matériaux à base d’alliages cuivreux, tels que le CuBe2 et le célèbre **ToughMet®**, en plus de nos
alliages hautes performances et barres d’aciers inoxydables.

[En savoir plus][100]

Stainless propose une gamme complète de matériaux métalliques pour les industries de la Marine, de
la Plaisance ou de l’Automobile. Un stock adapté à chaque secteur avec de nombreuses nuances en
**Titane Industriel, CuBe, ToughMet®, Aciers inxydables,  Aciers pou outils, Inconels, Nimonic 90…**

[En savoir plus][101]

Sur le marché des Microtechniques, Stainless intervient sur les marchés de Datacom-Télécoms,
Électronique, Automobile, Aéronautique, Médical, Horlogerie… en proposant des petits diamètres et
des feuillards très minces – jusqu’à 5 µm. Sa capacité de refendage lui donne un atout décisif. La
gamme s’étend du **cuivre-béryllium** aux **superalliages**, des **titanes et alliages** au
**ToughMet®** en passant par de nombreuses autres nuances.

[En savoir plus][102]

Stainless s’appuie sur plus de 90 années d’expérience du travail des métaux  pour proposer des
**poudres métalliques** à destination des marchés les plus exigeants (Aéronautique, médicale, 
Microtechniques ou encore de l’industrie).

Des **poudres fines en Titane**, **Aciers inoxydables**, **base cobalt**, **base cuivre**.

TDSG is the India’s First Lithium-ion Battery manufacturer for hybrid vehicles with Cell Level

Manufacturing

With cutting-edge research, top-tier engineering, and robust infrastructure, TDSG promises to meet
the nation's surging demand for hybrid electric vehicles and renewable energy storage. This
monumental project not only enhances self-reliance but also positions India as a global leader in
lithium-ion battery manufacturing, fostering economic growth and environmental stewardship.

High Quality
Product Delivery

crafted, rigorously tested, and thoughtfully packaged. We prioritize excellence in every detail,
ensuring our customers receive nothing but the finest products. Your satisfaction is our ultimate
goal, and we won't settle for anything less than perfection.

Economic Boost

Expanding lithium-ion battery production promises a significant economic boost. Increased demand for
electric vehicles and renewable energy storage drives growth opportunities. Job creation,
infrastructure development, and technology advancement are key benefits. Strategic investments and
sustainable practices can propel the company's success, contributing to a greener and more
prosperous future.

New Technology
Promise

technology enhances energy density, longevity, and safety. Say goodbye to frequent recharging and
hello to a sustainable future. Unleash the potential of Lithium-ion batteries with our innovation.
Join us in shaping the future of energy storage!

Government of India’s Make in India policy “AatmaNirbhar Bharat”, we have established operations in

already installed in hybrid vehicles, meet the rising demand for lithium-ion batteries. We aim to

# Trusted by Industry Around the Globe for
# Corrosion-Resistant Process Equipment.

TITAN Metal Fabricators designs and fabricates highly corrosion-resistant process equipment for any
industry that has corrosion problems, including:
* Chemical
* Petrochemical
* Oil & Gas Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG)
* Pharmaceutical
* Steel Industry
* Energy
* Geothermal
* Biomass
* Nuclear Power
* Solar Power Facilities
* Metal Finishing, Plating & Anodizing
* Mining
* Water Desalination

### TITAN Metal Fabricators equipment can be found around the world – anywhere corrosion is a
### problem to be solved.

Our primary business focus is on the manufacture of highly cost-effective process equipment such as
Shell and Tube Heat Exchangers, Columns & Towers, Condensers, Reactors, Pressure Vessels, Piping,
Piping Systems and Spargers. TITAN fabricators specialize in the reactive metals and
corrosion-resistant alloys:
* Titanium
* Tantalum
* Zirconium
* Niobium
* Hastelloy^{®}
* Monel^{®}
* Inconel^{®}
* High Nickel Alloys
* Duplex Stainless Steel
* Super Duplex Stainless Steel
* Lean Duplex Stainless Steel

Hastelloy is a registered trademark of [Haynes International, Inc][206].
Monel and Inconel are registered trademarks of [Special Metals Corporation][207].

Process equipment made from these materials can be used very effectively with extremely corrosive
fluids and will last for decades if designed and fabricated correctly. TITAN fabricators have the
knowledge and expertise to make sure all aspects of your project will come together – budget,
design, fabrication and schedule – to yield the most trouble-free installation possible.
Just as TITAN fabricators ensure precision and durability in their process equipment, you can trust
for high-quality offering timeless craftsmanship and lasting performance.

### TITAN Design Capacities:
* Diameter: 20 Feet (6 Meters)
* Length: 300 Feet (90 Meters)
* Weight: 200 Tons US (180t )
* Pressure: 2500 psig (170 Bar)
* Temperature: 1200º F (650º C)

### Industry Certifications, Design Codes and Standards:

TITAN manufactures pressure equipment in accordance with all major international design standards
and pressure vessel codes. ASME, PED/CE, AD2000 and Chinese GB Code are met and stamped as required.
* ASME
* PED/CE
* Chinese GB Code
* AD2000
* Japanese JIS
* TEMA
* API
* ASTM
* AWS

TITAN’s reputation for exceptional fabrication of reactive metals lies in its vast experience,
proven capabilities and high degree of personalized customer service. The company’s superior
manufacturing is tied to effective collaboration among TITAN’s team of engineers, skilled
manufacturing professionals, quality control engineers and proficient support team forming a genuine
partnership with our customers.

### Technical Resources

You’ll find product information, reactive metals information, corrosion charts, calculators and much
more in the TITAN **[Technical Resources Center][208]**.

### Questions?

TITAN Metal Fabricators would be pleased to work with you to resolve any of your project concerns.
Our world-class team, together with leading metallurgists and major specialists, is extremely
capable of resolving your most challenging corrosion, application, mechanical or thermal design
issues. Please **[contact us][209]** by phone at [**(805) 487-5050**][210] or toll free [**(877)
487-5050**][211]. email any questions to **[info@titanmf.com][212]**.

## AI for Materials. Delivered.

Total Materia Predictor leverages machine learning to offer precise material property modeling and
prediction, utilizing the largest curated properties dataset for unmatched accuracy.
* Single and multi-point predictions from 160 ML models across >300K materials
* Predict for >20 properties including mechanical, physical, stress-strain, and fatigue
* Predict properties and behavior from chemical composition
* Clear statistical confidence indicators to aid validation
* Share results with reports internally and externally
* Optimized results from synthetic, proprietary, and deep learning models

* Assess compliance of materials simultaneously against multiple regulations
* BOM assessment of substances, materials, and parts
* Assess Life Cycle Assessment for 40+ Indicators
* Accurate CO2 assessment with defined parameters
* Find more sustainable and compliant candidates from 570K materials
